For more information, read about [reconciliation](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_reconciliations) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Initial open items
tags.description:
Initial open items consist of outstanding checks, deposits, or other transactions that had not cleared the bank when you last reconciled the account but that were included in your opening General Ledger balances in Sage Intacct.

For more information, read about [initial open items](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_initial_open_items) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Credit card transactions
tags.description: Credit card transaction records contain comprehensive details about each credit card transaction, for example, payment amounts, exchange rate information and applicable taxes. Each record can contain multiple line items, each with individual amounts, currency information, payment amounts and tax details.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Credit card transaction lines
tags.description: Line items in a credit card transaction represent individual charges, adjustments or credits applied to credit and debit cards. Each line item contains detailed information such as amounts, currency, exchange rate, and tax information.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Credit card transaction tax entries
tags.description: Tax entry details for VAT enabled credit card transactions, each line item will have applicable tax entry information. Providing multiple entries is allowed if the tax solution supports it (AU, GB, FR). For ZA, only one tax entry is allowed.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Credit card transaction templates
tags.description: Credit card transaction templates provide a predefined structure to standardize credit card transactions. By applying a transaction template to each credit card transaction, you ensure the transaction is recorded consistently, with fields such as payee and tax implications automatically populated.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Credit card transaction line templates
tags.description: Credit card transaction line templates provide a predefined structure to standardize credit card transaction line items.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Credit card fees
tags.description:
Credit card fees are financial transactions that capture finance charges and other fees for a credit card, such as late charges or monthly interest fees. 

For more information, read [about credit card finance charges and fees](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_charge_card_fees) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Credit card fee lines
tags.description: Credit card fee lines represent credit card finance charges and other fees associated with a credit card fee. Create and maintain credit card fee lines from the owning credit card fee.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Credit card fee tax entries
tags.description:
Credit card fee tax entries contain tax entry details for VAT enabled credit card fee lines. Create and maintain bank fee tax entries from the owning bank fee line.

For more information, read about [entering taxable transactions](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Enter_taxable_transactions) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Credit card reconciliations
tags.description:
Credit card reconciliation records and matches bank statement activity with internal accounting transactions to ensure accuracy and align balances. There are three ways to reconcile a credit card in Sage Intacct, manually or by using bank files or bank feeds to automatically match transactions based on the rule set applied to the credit card.

For more information, watch the video, [reconcile a credit card account with bank feeds](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Video_reconcile_cc_bank_feeds) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Credit card reconciliation records
tags.description:
A credit card reconciliation record represents a single external credit card transaction. It contains detailed information about the transaction and is either manually added from the owning credit card reconciliation object or imported from a file or bank feed. During the reconciliation process it is matched to a transaction previously posted in the General Ledger (GL).

For more information, read [about reconciliation](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_reconciliations) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Deposits
tags.description:
Deposit transactions capture information about the deposit, such as the bank account, deposit date, and total amount. A deposit can have one or more deposit lines that represent the individual payments included in the deposit. 

For more information, read about [deposits](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=About_ar_deposits) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Deposit lines
tags.description:
Deposit lines represent individual customer payments included in a deposit transaction, including information needed to apply the payment to Accounts Receivable (AR). Create and maintain deposit lines in the owning [deposit](/intacct/apis/intacct/1/intacct-openapi/groups/cash-management/groups/deposits/tags/cash_management_deposits) object.

For more information, read [about deposits](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=About_ar_deposits) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Deposit details
tags.description:
Deposit details represent additional deposit information for individual customer payments included in a deposit transaction. Create and maintain deposit details in the owning [deposit](/intacct/apis/intacct/1/intacct-openapi/groups/cash-management/groups/deposits/tags/cash_management_deposits) object.

For more information, read [about deposits](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=About_ar_deposits) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Undeposited funds
tags.description:
An undeposited funds object represents a temporary holding account used to record customer payments, such as checks and cash payments, before they are deposited into a bank account. It allows you to record receipts without immediately assigning them to a specific deposit date or bank. 

For more information read [about deposits](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=About_ar_deposits) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Funds transfers
tags.description:
A funds transfer is a transaction that records the movement of funds from one cash account to another. Cash accounts include checking accounts and savings accounts.

For more information, read [about funds transfers](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Funds_transfers_overview) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Funds transfer lines
tags.description:
Funds transfer lines are automatically generated when a funds transfer is created. Each line item is posted to the general ledger when the transaction is created. Create and maintain funds transfer lines in the owning [funds transfer](/intacct/apis/intacct/1/intacct-openapi/groups/cash-management/groups/funds-transfers/tags/cash_management_funds-transfers) object.

For more information, read [about funds transfers](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Funds_transfers_overview) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Other receipts
tags.description:
Other receipts represent incoming payments that are not linked to specific customers or invoices. They are typically used to record miscellaneous income or non-invoice related deposits. These transactions may include cash deposits, credit card payments, bank transfers or check receipts.

For more information, read [about other receipts](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=About_other_receipts) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Other receipt lines
tags.description:
Other receipt lines represent the individual postings in an other receipt object. Each line includes details like amount, account and dimensions, such as location or department, along with information about the associated General Ledger (GL) posting. Create and maintain other receipt lines in the owning [other-receipt](/intacct/apis/intacct/1/intacct-openapi/groups/cash-management/groups/other-receipts/tags/cash_management_other-receipts) object.

For more information, see [other receipts](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_other_receipts) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Other receipt tax entries
tags.description:
Other receipt tax entries contain tax details for the associated order entry and other receipt line. Create and maintain other receipt tax entries in the owning [other-receipt-line](/intacct/apis/intacct/1/intacct-openapi/groups/cash-management/groups/other-receipts/tags/cash_management_other-receipt-lines) object.

For more information, see [tax details](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Tax_details_vat) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Received payments
tags.description:
Received payments provide the ability to receive and record a full or partial payment made by a customer against specific invoices. You can also create advance payments when no invoices match the bank transactions or save the payment as draft if you are not ready to post the payment. You can create and update received payment lines in the owning received payment object.

For more information, read about [received payments](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Receive_payments) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Received payment lines
tags.description:
Line items represent details for each received payment or advance, including the bank transaction record and the Sage Intacct transaction record.

For more information, read about [received payments](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Receive_payments) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_AR advance transaction templates
tags.description:
AR advance transaction templates define how to create new advance transactions in Sage Intacct based on data from an import file or bank feed. When you receive a payment, you have the option to create an advance, these templates determine how to create the advance.

For more information, read about [AR advance transaction templates](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=AR_advance_transaction_template) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_AR advance transaction line templates
tags.description:
AR advance transaction line templates define the line-level details for AR advance transactions. Each line template specifies how portions of an AR advance transaction are recorded in the General Ledger (GL), including account and dimension assignments.

For more information, read about [AR advance transaction templates](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=AR_advance_transaction_template) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Journal entry templates
tags.description:
Journal entry templates store predefined information used to populate journal entries generated from them. They include journal entry line templates, which define the individual lines of a journal entry created from the template, specifying information such as account details and amounts.

If using a creation rule for reconciliation, the rule must reference a journal entry template.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Journal entry line templates
tags.description: Journal entry line templates store predefined information to quickly populate the lines of a journal entry generated from a journal entry template. Create and maintain journal entry line templates from the owning journal entry template object.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Payment providers
tags.description:
Provides information about subscribed payment providers. For example, if an account includes a subscription to Vendor Payments powered by CSI, you can use these operations to retrieve information for that payment provider.
Payment provider services, like Vendor Payments powered by CSI, are only for US vendors accepting USD. See [Compare payment methods](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=HDI_Select_Payment_Method) for more information.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Payment provider bank accounts
tags.description:
Models the bank accounts associated with a payment provider for electronic payments. After the subscription status for a payment provider is Subscribed, you can add bank accounts for that payment provider. Subscribed status is set after your company's application has been received by the payment provider and all required paperwork has been signed.
Payment provider services, like Vendor Payments powered by CSI, are only for US vendors accepting USD. See [Compare payment methods](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=HDI_Select_Payment_Method) for more information.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Provider payment methods
tags.description:
Provides relevant information for a subscribed payment provider's supported payment methods. After confirming a payment provider's information, you can associate a vendor and a bank account with that payment provider. See [Payment provider bank accounts](/intacct/apis/intacct/1/intacct-openapi/groups/cash-management/groups/payment-providers/tags/cash_management_payment-provider-bank-accounts) and [Vendor payment providers](/intacct/apis/intacct/1/intacct-openapi/groups/accounts-payable/groups/vendors/tags/accounts_payable_vendor-payment-providers) to learn more. 
Payment provider services, like Vendor Payments powered by CSI, are only for US vendors accepting USD. See [Compare payment methods](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=HDI_Select_Payment_Method) for more information.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Check register reports
tags.description:
The check register report shows check and payment transactions for a bank account over a specified date range.

**When to use:** Use to review check activity, reconcile payments, and analyze cash movement for a bank account during the reporting and close process.

**Relationships:** Uses the selected bank account and date range to return check and payment details for reconciliation, cash reporting, and account-level analysis.

**Lifecycle context:** Supports the reconciliation and reporting steps of the cash management workflow by summarizing payment activity for a defined reporting period.

tags.name: Cash_Management_Bank register reports
tags.description:
The bank register report shows transactions for a bank account (debits, credits, and reconciliation status) over a specified date range.

**When to use:** Use to review cash activity for a bank account, reconcile posted transactions, and analyze account activity by date and reconciliation status.

**Relationships:** Uses the selected bank account and date range to return transaction details for cash movement, reconciliation, and account-level reporting.

**Lifecycle context:** Helps finance teams reconcile bank activity during the reporting and close process by summarizing transaction activity for a defined period.

tags.name: Common_Resources_Models
tags.description: Use the model service to find details about a resource, such as an object's queryable fields and their data types, valid values (for enums) and relationships to other objects. You can use any of those within the select and/or filter elements of a query. The model service works with all resource types including standard objects, custom objects, services, and workflows.

tags.name: Common_Resources_Query
tags.description: The query service lets you query the data in a Sage Intacct company to return a list of objects that match given conditions. You can specify complex filter expressions and define the list of fields that you want included for each object in the results.

tags.name: Common_Resources_Allowed operations
tags.description: Returns allowed operations for specified instances of an object type. Note that individual users may have role or permission settings that restrict them from performing certain operations.

tags.name: Common_Resources_Bulk requests
tags.description: Use the bulk service to send multiple operations for one REST object for asynchronous processing. See the [Bulk requests](/intacct/docs/1/sage-intacct-rest-api/api-essentials/bulk-requests#bulk-requests) topic for more details.

tags.name: Common_Resources_Bulk status requests
tags.description: Use the bulk status service to monitor the status of a bulk request.

tags.name: Common_Resources_Composite requests
tags.description: Composite request service for submitting multiple "subrequests" in a single POST request. See the [Composite request service guide](/intacct/docs/1/sage-intacct-rest-api/api-essentials/bulk-requests#composite-requests) for a full description and examples.

tags.name: Common_Resources_Session IDs
tags.description:
Obtains an XML API session ID using a REST API access token, which can then be used for XML API calls. The request must include a valid `Bearer` token with appropriate permissions in the `Authorization` header.

Each session ID is unique and is associated with the specific access token. Keep session IDs secure and don't expose them in logs or client-side code.

tags.name: Common_Resources_Transaction definitions
tags.description: Template for a transaction definition.

tags.name: Common_Resources_Exports
tags.description: Use the export service to export data out of Sage Intacct. Export the complete objects you need or filter to export granular data, for example only invoices from January through March.

tags.name: Common_Resources_Operations
tags.description: Details of scheduled action that automates execution of recurring jobs.

tags.name: Common_Resources_Schedules
tags.description: Defines the scheduling details for recurring transactions, including start date, frequency, next execution date, and end conditions.

tags.name: Common_Resources_Scheduled operations
tags.description: Maps the scheduling details and the operation for recurring transactions.

tags.name: Common_Resources_View service
tags.description:
Use the view service to execute a [system view](/intacct/apis/intacct/1/intacct-openapi/groups/common-resources/groups/views/tags/common_resources_system-views) or [user view](/intacct/apis/intacct/1/intacct-openapi/groups/common-resources/groups/views/tags/common_resources_user-views) and get the data that matches the view's filter and sort options at the time of execution. 

Any parameters that you provide in the request body override the same parameters defined in the view. For example, if a view is defined to return 10 records but you set `size` to 20 in the request body, the response will include 20 records.

tags.name: Common_Resources_System views
tags.description:
System views are pre-defined query filters for objects, and are used in Sage Intacct to display data in ways that meet the needs of most users. Each time you execute a view, the response includes all data that matches the filtering and sorting options set up in the view.

System views cannot be changed, but users can use the UI to create user views based on them. For example, a user could create a user view that uses the same filter as a system view but returns different fields.

Use the [view service](/intacct/apis/intacct/1/intacct-openapi/groups/common-resources/groups/views/tags/common_resources_view-service) to execute a system view and get the data that matches the view's filter and sort options. 

Note: Queries for system views must use a very specific set of `filters` in the request body, as shown in this example:

  ```
  object: system-view
  fields:
    - key
    - id
    - name
    - description
    - query
  filters:
    - $eq:
        object: expenses/electronic-receipt
    - $eq:
        contexts: __default
    - $eq:
        id: getAllVendors
  ```
  
  System view query rules:

  * The only supported filter is `$eq`.
  * Filtering by context is done via the `$eq` operation on the `contexts` field, and can only be a single context. If you need to query for more than one context you must execute 2 separate queries.
  * If `id` is not provided the query will return all system views in a specific context.
  * If `id` is unique across all contexts, the `context` filter is not required.

tags.name: Common_Resources_User views
tags.description:
User views are stored queries on objects that can be used to get a filtered list of objects based on current data at any given time. User views can be created and modified through the UI or the API, and can be restricted to the user who creates one or made available to all users.

Use the [view service](/intacct/apis/intacct/1/intacct-openapi/groups/common-resources/groups/views/tags/common_resources_view-service) to execute a view and get the data that matches the view's filter and sort options. 

Note that user views are not the same as custom views, although they are similar. This API object and operations only apply to user views.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Dimensions
tags.description: Dimensions are a classification system used to organize, sort, and report on company information in meaningful ways. You can think of each dimension as a category with a set of values that you can apply to transactions and entries. Every transaction can be tagged with multiple dimension values to identify and report on it. For example, you can tag transactions with pre-defined locations, and then generate reports to show sales by each location.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Classes
tags.description:
Class is a flexible dimension that can be defined in a company and used to track just about anything. You can rename the class dimension and add custom fields if needed, and then select a class and provide values for the fields in applicable transactions. You can use the data to create custom reports that provide important business insights.

**When to use:** Use to tag transactions with a class value for custom reporting and business insights.

**Relationships:** A class can have a parent class, forming a class hierarchy.

Note that renaming the class dimension in the UI does not change the name of this object in the API. You still use `class` in API requests.

For more information, see [Class](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Adding_Editing_Viewing_Class_Information) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Class groups
tags.description:
Classes are a dimension used to tag transaction lines for reporting, and a class group is a named set of classes used to filter or aggregate class data in financial reports.

**When to use:** Use when creating report views that group classes together by specific criteria or a curated list, or when retrieving an existing class group configuration.

**Relationships:** Contains class group members that reference individual classes. Can be associated with a specific entity.

For more information, see [Class groups](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=about_class_groups) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Departments
tags.description:
Department is an optional [dimension](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Dimensions_overview_basics) that can be used for tagging, filtering, and categorizing data in many areas of Sage Intacct.

**When to use:** Use when tagging, filtering, and categorizing data by department.

**Relationships:** The list of departments is shared by all entities in a company. Users can be restricted to only work with and see specific departments, which might affect what data they can see in reports, transactions, and other data records.

You can create a hierarchy of departments to reflect how departments are organized within a company. To set up a hierarchy, create the parent departments first and then specify the parent department when adding child departments.

**Lifecycle context:** Create parent departments before child departments when setting up a hierarchy; departments are then used to categorize company data.

For more information, see [Departments](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Department_Information) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Department groups
tags.description:
A department group is a specified set of departments, or a set of departments that meet certain criteria. You can use groups to filter or display information in multiple ways, for instance by showing data from only certain departments.

**When to use:** Use when filtering or displaying information for a specified set of departments or departments matching criteria.

**Relationships:** Contains department group members and can use membership filters.

**Lifecycle context:** Configured before reports use the group to select or organize departments.

For more information, see [Department groups](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=about_department_groups) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Department group members
tags.description:
Department group member represents a department in a department group.

**When to use:** Use when retrieving a department included in a department group and its report sort order.

**Relationships:** Belongs to a department group and references the department it represents.

**Lifecycle context:** Included when setting up a group and retained as part of that group for reporting.

For more information, see [Department groups](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=about_department_groups) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Employees
tags.description:
An employee in Sage Intacct represents someone who performs work for a company. They may create financial transactions such as timesheet entries or expense reports. If an employee who is also a user is entering time or expenses, they must both be associated with the same Sage Intacct contact.

**When to use:** Use when maintaining employee details and the references used for timesheets, expenses, payments, and labor costs.

**Relationships:** Linked to employee, location, department, class, customer, item, vendor, transaction allocation template, contact, employee type, earning type, employee position, employee bank file setup, folder, employee rate, and position skill.

**Lifecycle context:** Configured before employee-related transactions are entered and maintained as employment and payment details change.

For more information, see [employees](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_te_employees) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Employee types
tags.description:
Employee types are customizable classifications that can be defined in a company and assigned to employees to enhance reporting and insight into the value delivered by different employee categories, such as contractor, full-time, and part-time. Defining and assigning types to different employees allows you to report on and assess the value being delivered to a project, location, or other dimension on a per-employee type basis.

**When to use:** Use when maintaining employee classifications and their hierarchy, and reviewing associated 1099 information.

**Relationships:** Linked to a parent employee type and assigned to employees.

**Lifecycle context:** Configured before it is assigned to employees and used to group their information in reports.

For more information, see [Employee types](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Adding_Editing_and_Viewing_Employee_Type_Information) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Employee rates
tags.description:
Employee rates provide employee compensation details, this can be either an hourly rate or annual salary.

**When to use:** Use when retrieving employee compensation rates and the dates during which they apply.

**Relationships:** Owned by the employee.

**Lifecycle context:** Maintained with the employee as compensation rates and effective dates change.

For more information, see [Field descriptions: Employee information—Projects](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Fbf_proj_employee_info) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Employee groups
tags.description:
Organize employees into employee groups to simplify reporting. Create employee groups that are specific to your business, then assign an employee group to each employee.

**When to use:** Use when organizing employee information for reporting and retrieving group members and filters.

**Relationships:** Linked to employee.

**Lifecycle context:** Configured before grouped employee data is used in reports.

For more information, see [Employee groups](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=About_employee_dimension_groups) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Employee bank file setups
tags.description:
An employee bank file setup contains the information needed to send electronic payments to a specified employee using bank files. Bank files are standard files used by banks to make multiple payments, they are generated in Sage Intacct and then uploaded to the bank's online banking portal for processing.

**When to use:** Use when retrieving the payment details used to generate electronic bank file payments for an employee.

**Relationships:** Owned by the employee.

**Lifecycle context:** Configured for the employee before bank files are generated and uploaded for processing.

For more information, read [Set up an employee for bank file and ACH payments](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=bank-file-employee-setup) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Earning types
tags.description:
Earning types are a key component in configuring the system to post project labor costs to one or more General Ledger journals. After creating earning types, they must be assigned to employees.

**When to use:** Use when managing billable and non-billable labor accounts, calculation methods, and rate multipliers.

**Relationships:** Linked to account.

**Lifecycle context:** Configured before it is assigned to employees whose labor costs use those settings.

For more information, see [Earning types](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Adding_Editing_Viewing_Earning_Type_Information) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Locations
tags.description:
A location is a dimension for geographic offices or facilities, or a company division when that is more significant than geography; locations can be set on transactions to provide reporting insights and organized into a hierarchy that reflects the company.

**When to use:** Use when maintaining location hierarchies and the dimension values used on transactions and in reports.

**Relationships:** Can have a parent location, contacts, a manager, and an associated entity; locations can also be used on transactions.

**Lifecycle context:** Configured before transactions and reports use locations to categorize company data.

For more information, see [Dimensions overview](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Dimensions_overview_basics) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Location groups
tags.description:
A location group is a named set of locations used to filter or aggregate location data in reports and graphs, such as grouping all active locations or locations with the same base currency; location groups are a type of dimension group.

**When to use:** Use when creating report views or financial graphs that group locations by specific criteria or a curated list.

**Relationships:** Contains location group members that reference individual locations. A location group can have a primary contact and be associated with a specific entity.

**Lifecycle context:** Configured before reports use the group's members, filters, and display order.

For more information, see [Location groups](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=about_location_groups) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Location group members
tags.description:
A location group member represents an individual location included in a location group.

**When to use:** Use when adding or removing locations from a location group, or retrieving the locations that belong to a specific group.

**Relationships:** Owned by a location group and linked to an individual location.

**Lifecycle context:** Created with group membership configuration and retained with its owning location group.

For more information, see [Set up location groups](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=set_up_location_groups) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Attachments
tags.description:
An attachment contains an array of one or more files that are stored in Sage Intacct. You
can attach multiple files of any type to a transaction using an attachment, such as scanned
images, spreadsheets, and word-processor documents. For example, you might add ten scanned
images to a single attachment for a bill. You can also add attachments to some other objects,
such as customers, vendors, and employees.

**When to use:** Use to attach supporting files to a transaction or other record, or to add,
update, or remove individual files from an existing attachment.

**Relationships:** Each transaction or record can have only one attachment assigned to it.
Every attachment is stored in an attachment [folder](/intacct/apis/intacct/1/intacct-openapi/groups/company-configuration/groups/attachments/tags/company_configuration_folders), which must exist
before you create the attachment.

For more information, see [Attachments](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_attachments) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Files
tags.description:
A file is a digital attachment, such as a scanned image, spreadsheet, or word-processing document; you can attach multiple files of any type to a record or transaction. Use POST and PATCH requests on the owning attachment to create or modify files.

**When to use:** Use when retrieving attached file content or metadata, or when preparing file data to create or modify through an attachment.

**Relationships:** Owned by the attachment.

**Lifecycle context:** Created or modified through the owning attachment's POST or PATCH request and retained with that attachment.

For more information, see [Attachments](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Attachments_overview) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Folders
tags.description:
A folder stores attachments for easy grouping, such as supporting documents for a project, and folders can be nested into a hierarchy as broad or deep as needed.

**When to use:** Use when grouping project or other supporting documents in an attachment folder hierarchy.

**Relationships:** Can contain subfolders and attachments and can have a parent folder.

**Lifecycle context:** Configured before attachments are grouped in it and maintained as the folder hierarchy changes.

For more information, see [Attachments](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Attachments_overview) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Contacts
tags.description:
Contacts serve as a common, shared address book that's used across a company by many people for a variety of purposes. Contacts hold all the information needed to contact an individual or business, including name, email address, phone number, mailing address, and more.

**When to use:** Use when managing communication information and addresses used across company records and transactions.

**Relationships:** Contacts are almost always used with other Sage Intacct objects, such as vendors, customers, or locations. For example, you specify a contact in Order Entry and Purchasing transactions to set ship-to, bill-to, pay-to, or return-to addresses, and to determine tax on transactions.

**Lifecycle context:** Created before being referenced by other records or transactions and updated when contact information changes.

For more information, see [Contacts](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Adding_Editing_and_Viewing_Contact_Information) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Contact versions
tags.description:
Contact version captures the history of changes to a [contact](/intacct/apis/intacct/1/intacct-openapi/groups/company-configuration/tags/company_configuration_contacts). Each time a contact record is updated, the previous version is saved and the new version is added. For AP/AR transactions, Sage Intacct stores a reference to the contact version for the bill-to, ship-to, pay-to, and return-to when the invoice is created. If the contact changes after the invoice is created, the contact version provides the original contact information when the invoice was created.

**When to use:** Use when retrieving the contact information retained for an invoice, even after the contact has changed.

**Relationships:** References the original contact and is referenced by AP/AR transactions for bill-to, ship-to, pay-to, and return-to information.

**Lifecycle context:** Each contact update saves the previous version and adds a new version; an invoice retains the contact version from the time it was created.

The contact reference includes a key, ID, and link to the original contact. The ID always represents the contact name; the contact key can be null if the original contact was deleted.

For more information, see [Contacts](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Adding_Editing_and_Viewing_Contact_Information) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Document sequences
tags.description:
Use document sequencing to generate new IDs automatically for common transactions and records, such as new customers, vendors, invoices, and more. For example, you can create a document sequence for invoices. This new sequence automatically creates a new ID, such as 'INV-0100' and increments the number each time a new invoice is created.

Note: Document sequences are called "accounting sequences" in the General Ledger.

**When to use:** Use when configuring automatic IDs for transactions and records.

**Relationships:** Can be associated with an entity and contain fiscal year rollover entries.

**Lifecycle context:** Configured before transactions or records use it to generate IDs; the sequence advances as new IDs are generated.

For more information, see [Document sequences](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Adding_Editing_Viewing_Document_Numbering_Information) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Generate next value
tags.description: Generates a new (incremented) value for a specified document sequence. When `fiscalYear` is specified, it is appended to the document sequence.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Document sequence rollovers
tags.description:
The document sequence rollover configuration holds the next number or alpha values used to generate sequences for each fiscal year. When rollover is enabled for a document sequence, a restart of the document sequence is initiated for each fiscal year.

If the configuration for a fiscal year is missing, it is automatically generated by the system when the first sequence is generated. When the system generates a configuration, the next number or alpha values from the base start values are used.

**When to use:** Use when retrieving or managing the fiscal-year restart values for a document sequence.

**Relationships:** Owned by the document sequence.

**Lifecycle context:** Used when fiscal-year rollover is enabled; missing fiscal-year configurations are generated when the first sequence is requested.

For more information, see [Fiscal year rollover for document sequences](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Document_Sequence_Redirect) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Email templates
tags.description:
An email template defines reusable content, recipients, and attachment options for transaction email.

Use email templates to organize email content and add style to make emails stand out to customers and vendors. You can create a variety of email templates to use for different types of transactions, different vendors, or different customers. You can add merge fields to populate emails with dynamic data from Sage Intacct, such as the vendor name, contact information, and so on.

**When to use:** Use when preparing email content that combines text, HTML, and merge fields for customers or vendors.

**Lifecycle context:** Configured before transaction emails are generated using the template.

For more information, see [Email templates](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Creating_an_email_template) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Entities
tags.description:
In a multi-entity shared company, entities represent a separate tax identification or a separately secured, fully balancing set of books. Entities typically represent divisions, franchises, affiliates, associations, locations, chapters, self-balancing funds or subsidiaries, with a shared chart of accounts.

**When to use:** Use when maintaining entity identity, operating dates, tax details, and accounting configuration.

**Relationships:** Linked to transaction currency, customer, vendor, account, employee, and tax solution.

**Lifecycle context:** Configured before entity-specific transactions, reporting, and inter-entity processing use its settings.

For more information, see [Entities](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Adding_Editing_and_Viewing_Entity_Information) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Affiliate entities
tags.description:
An affiliate entity is a read-only standard dimension representing a related legal entity defined within
your Sage Intacct company.

**When to use:** Use to tag a related entity on a transaction, simplifying reporting for inter-entity
transactions and consolidation.

**Relationships:** Referenced by transactions to indicate the related legal entity for reporting and
consolidation purposes.

For more information, see [Affiliate entity standard dimension](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_affiliate_entity_dimension) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Affiliate entity groups
tags.description:
An affiliate entity group is a collection of affiliate entities defined for reporting purposes — for
example, grouping parent entity E100 with related entities E200 and E500.

**When to use:** Use to organize affiliate entities into named groups that can be added to the rows or
columns of a financial report.

**Relationships:** Made up of individual affiliate entity records, selected explicitly or by filter
criteria.

For more information, see [Reporting with affiliate entities](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=About_reporting_with_AE) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Inter-entity account mappings
tags.description:
Inter-entity account mapping configures accounts for all entities in multi-entity shared companies to post inter-entity transactions (IETs), using either a basic plan with one common set of inter-entity accounts or an advanced plan with separate account sets for each entity relationship, or entity pair.

**When to use:** Use when configuring IET accounts for entities in a multi-entity shared company.

**Relationships:** Contains basic or advanced inter-entity account maps that associate entities and accounts used to post IETs.

**Lifecycle context:** Configured before inter-entity transactions are posted.

For more information, see [Inter-entity account mapping plans](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Inter-entity_account_map_plans) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Inter entity basic maps
tags.description:
Basic inter-entity account mapping enables a multi-entity company to map entities to accounts that post inter-entity transactions (IETs). It uses one common inter-entity receivable (IER) account and one inter-entity payable (IEP) account to record all IETs when separate balances among the entities involved do not need to be settled.

**When to use:** Use when a multi-entity company uses one common IER and IEP account and does not need to settle separate balances among the entities involved.

**Relationships:** Belongs to a basic inter-entity account mapping plan and links entities to common IER and IEP accounts.

**Lifecycle context:** Configured before inter-entity transactions are posted.

For more information, see [Inter-entity account setup](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Account_setup_for_interentity_txns) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Inter entity advanced maps
tags.description:
Advanced inter-entity account mapping enables a multi-entity company to map pairs of transacting entities using up to four accounts to record inter-entity transactions (IETs). Each entity pair can use a combination of separate inter-entity receivable (IER) and inter-entity payable (IEP) accounts.

**When to use:** Use when different entity pairs need separate IER and IEP accounts for IETs.

**Relationships:** Belongs to an advanced inter-entity account mapping plan and maps a pair of transacting entities.

**Lifecycle context:** Configured before IETs between the mapped entities are posted.

For more information, see [Inter-entity account setup](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Account_setup_for_interentity_txns) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Exchange rates
tags.description:
Exchange rates convert one currency to another when a company chooses not to use the Intacct Daily Rate. An exchange rate can have multiple entries (lines), each with an effective start date, a conversion rate and its reciprocal rate used when processing currency conversions in transactions.

**When to use:** Use when maintaining currency conversions that use rates other than the Intacct Daily Rate.

**Relationships:** Linked to exchange rate type and exchange rate line.

**Lifecycle context:** Configured with effective-dated lines before transactions use the conversion rates.

For more information, see [exchange rates](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Adding_Editing_and_Viewing_an_Exchange_Rate) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Exchange rate lines
tags.description:
Exchange rate lines are entries within an exchange rate object that contain details such as effective start date, exchange rate, and reciprocal rate. Each line is owned by an [exchange rate](/intacct/apis/intacct/1/intacct-openapi/groups/company-configuration/groups/exchange-rates/tags/company_configuration_exchange-rates) object.

**When to use:** Use when retrieving the dated rate entries used to convert between an exchange rate's currencies.

**Relationships:** Owned by the exchange rate.

**Lifecycle context:** Created within an exchange rate and used from its effective start date.

For more information, see [exchange rates](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Adding_Editing_and_Viewing_an_Exchange_Rate) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Exchange rate types
tags.description:
Exchange rate types control how currency conversions are applied in Sage Intacct, enabling foreign currency transactions to use exchange rates tailored to specific business needs. Use exchange rate types to set an alternative default rate type, create custom types or override the standard Intacct Daily Rate.

**When to use:** Use when managing custom rate types and selecting the default exchange rate type.

**Relationships:** Linked to exchange rates that use this type.

**Lifecycle context:** Configured before exchange rates and transactions use the selected type.

For more information, see [exchange rate types](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Adding_Editing_and_Viewing_an_Exchange_Rate_Type) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Users
tags.description:
A user is an individual who has access to some part of Sage Intacct. Most users are employees, but users can also be external users outside the company, such as accountants, attorneys, bankers, vendors, customers, or auditors. Anyone who logs in through the user interface or API must have a unique user record.

**When to use:** Use users to manage access to Sage Intacct for employees and external users.

**Relationships:** A user is associated with a contact and can be assigned roles, permissions, and access to entities, departments, territories, and products.

**Lifecycle context:** Associate each user with a new or existing contact when creating the user. After a user logs in, the user cannot be deleted; the record is retained to maintain the audit trail.

For more information, see [Users](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Users_overview) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_User groups
tags.description:
A user group manages permissions and access for users who have the same roles or responsibilities in a company.

**When to use:** Use user groups to assign shared permissions and access to multiple users at once or to retrieve user group configurations.

**Relationships:** Add or remove users from a user group through the user group member API. Roles assigned to the group define the permissions inherited by its members.

**Lifecycle context:** Users inherit the permissions and access defined by a group's assigned roles after they are added to the group. When users belong to multiple groups, the access privileges closest to the user prevail.

For more information, see [User groups](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=About_user_groups) and [Access privileges for users in multiple groups](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Access_Privileges_In_Multiple_Groups) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_User group members
tags.description:
A user group member represents a user's membership in a user group.

**When to use:** Use to assign a user to a group to manage shared permissions and access, retrieve group membership, or remove a user from a group.

**Relationships:** Each membership links a user to a user group.

**Lifecycle context:** Create a membership when adding a user to a group, and delete it when the user should no longer inherit permissions and access from that group.

For more information, see [Adding users to a user group](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Adding_Members_to_a_group) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Roles
tags.description:
A role groups permissions so administrators can assign a consistent set of access rights to multiple users. Roles are used in companies with role-based permissions; companies with user-based permissions do not use roles. Permissions for specific tasks are assigned to roles, and [role permission assignments](/intacct/apis/intacct/1/intacct-openapi/groups/company-configuration/groups/users-roles-and-permissions/tags/company_configuration_role-permission-assignments) define those permissions.

**When to use:** Use roles to define access for job functions, such as giving all Accounts Receivable clerks the same permissions, or to transfer a departing employee's access to a replacement. A user can have more than one role and receives the permissions from each role. For example, a user assigned both Role A and Role B receives the permissions from both roles, including permissions that are unique to either role. A user can also have roles assigned individually and through a user group; the user's effective access includes the permissions from all assigned roles.

**Relationships:** Roles contain role permission assignments and can be assigned to users or user groups. If a company uses role-based permissions, each user must be assigned to a role directly or through a user group with an assigned role; users without an associated role cannot access applications and features.

For more information, see [Manage roles](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Roles_information) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Role user maps
tags.description:
A role user map associates a role with a user and is owned by the [role](/intacct/apis/intacct/1/intacct-openapi/groups/company-configuration/groups/users-roles-and-permissions/tags/company_configuration_roles). Sage Intacct creates a role user map automatically when a role is assigned to a user in the `roles` array of a `user`. When that array is updated, Sage Intacct deletes all role user maps for the user and creates new maps for the updated roles.

**When to use:** Use role user maps to retrieve or review the roles assigned to users.

**Relationships:** Each role user map links one role to one user. Roles are used in companies with role-based permissions; companies with user-based permissions do not use roles.

For more information, see [View roles by user or user group](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=View_roles_by_user) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Role user group maps
tags.description:
A role user group map associates a role with a user group and is owned by the [role](/intacct/apis/intacct/1/intacct-openapi/groups/company-configuration/groups/users-roles-and-permissions/tags/company_configuration_roles). Sage Intacct creates a role user group map automatically when a role is assigned to a user group in the `roles` array of a `user-group`. When that array is updated, Sage Intacct deletes all role user group maps for the user group and creates new maps for the updated roles.

**When to use:** Use role user group maps to retrieve or review the roles assigned to user groups.

**Relationships:** Each role user group map links one role to one user group. Roles are used in companies with role-based permissions; companies with user-based permissions do not use roles.

For more information, see [View roles by user or user group](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=View_roles_by_user) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Permissions
tags.description:
A permission enables users to perform a particular function or task within a specific area of Sage Intacct. For example, a user might have permission within General Ledger to view financial reports but not to create, edit, or delete them. A permission specifies a module, such as `accountsPayable`, a permission name, such as `vendors`, and the allowed access rights, such as `list`, `view`, `add`, and `edit`.

**When to use:** Use permissions to review the functions available in each module and the access rights that can be assigned.

**Relationships:** Permissions specify a module, permission name, and allowed access rights. Use [role permission assignments](/intacct/apis/intacct/1/intacct-openapi/groups/company-configuration/groups/users-roles-and-permissions/tags/company_configuration_role-permission-assignments) to assign permissions to roles.

For more information, see [Permissions](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Permissions_default) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Role permission assignments
tags.description:
A role permission assignment defines one permission and its access rights for a role. It is owned by a [role](/intacct/apis/intacct/1/intacct-openapi/groups/company-configuration/groups/users-roles-and-permissions/tags/company_configuration_roles). You create, update, and delete role permission assignments through the `rolePermissionAssignments` array in the owning role.

**When to use:** Use role permission assignments to retrieve or maintain the permissions and access rights assigned to a role.

**Relationships:** Each assignment links a role with a permission and its access rights. Roles are used in companies with role-based permissions; companies with user-based permissions do not use roles.

For more information, see [Assign permissions to roles](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Assign_permissions_roles) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Audit histories
tags.description: Audit history provides detailed information about field-level modifications made to a particular object.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Advanced audit histories
tags.description:
An advanced audit history record provides detailed information about access to personal data stored in
contact, customer, and vendor records.

**When to use:** Use to retrieve audit records that show who accessed or modified personal data and when,
to support compliance monitoring and reporting for data protection laws such as HIPAA.

**Relationships:** Linked to the contact, customer, and vendor records whose personal data was accessed
or modified.

For more information, see [Advanced audit trail overview](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_advanced_audit_trail) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Cloud storage
tags.description:
Cloud storage defines targets for delivery of report output, such as Amazon S3, Dropbox, Google Drive, Box, OneDrive, Azure Storage, or a generic HTTP endpoint.

**When to use:** Use to set up and manage where report output is delivered.

**Relationships:** References the user who owns the cloud storage target.

For more information, see [Cloud Storage for reports](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Setting_up_cloud_storage) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Company messages
tags.description:
Use company messages to share short announcements or reminders with users. For example, remind employees to submit weekly timesheets or announce an upcoming company holiday.

**When to use:** Use to create and manage short announcements shown to users in a company.

**Relationships:** References the user who posted the message and, optionally, an entity.

For more information, see [Company messages](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=company_messages) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Cover letter templates
tags.description:
A cover letter template is a document you can include in a group of reports. When you send the group of reports, use the cover letter to introduce the reports and describe what information they contain. In Intacct, you can create a cover letter and include it in a memorized report group.

**When to use:** Use when preparing an introduction to reports distributed as a group.

**Relationships:** Contains a Microsoft Word template file and can be included in a memorized report group.

**Lifecycle context:** Prepared before a report group is sent and used to introduce the reports and describe their contents.

For more information, see [Cover letters for report groups](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Adding_Editing_and_Viewing_Cover_Letters) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Email delivery records
tags.description:
The delivery record for the email delivery service lets you check whether any sent email encountered errors.

**When to use:** Use when reviewing email delivery activity and investigating failed messages.

**Lifecycle context:** Created during email delivery and updated as delivery status changes.

For more information, see [Email delivery log](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Viewing_Troubleshooting_Email_Errors) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_External authorizations
tags.description:
An external authorization grants another Sage Intacct company access to your company.

Use an external authorization record to allow another Sage Intacct company to access your company externally for a specified time period or until you disable the access.

**When to use:** Use when managing external access, its purpose, and its expiration date.

**Lifecycle context:** Configured before external access is used and maintained as access is extended or disabled.

For more information, see [External authorizations](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=External_authorizations) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Holidays
tags.description:
A holiday is a date established for a company and associated with a holiday schedule.

**When to use:** Use when adding or retrieving a date that affects timesheet entry or pay handling under a holiday schedule.

**Relationships:** Owned by and linked to a holiday schedule; can also be associated with a timesheet rule and entity.

**Lifecycle context:** Created as part of a holiday schedule before timesheets are entered and processed for that date.

For more information, see [Holiday schedules](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Adding_Editing_Viewing_a_Schedule_of_Company_Holidays) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Holiday schedules
tags.description:
A holiday schedule is a related group of individual holidays. You can configure the system to automatically reject timesheets with time worked on a designated holiday or apply a different pay scale for hourly workers who are allowed to work on holidays.

**When to use:** Use when managing holidays that determine whether time can be entered or is paid at a different scale on designated dates.

**Relationships:** Contains individual holidays and can be associated with an entity and timesheet rule.

**Lifecycle context:** Configured before timesheets are entered and processed for the listed holidays.

For more information, see [Holiday schedules](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Adding_Editing_Viewing_a_Schedule_of_Company_Holidays) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Payment provider notifications
tags.description:
A payment provider notification is a message that Sage Intacct receives from a payment provider and processes to update a record based on the notification type. The notification includes the provider's detailed payload, its processing state, and any error description when processing fails.

**When to use:** Use payment provider notifications to review messages received from payment providers and determine whether Sage Intacct processed them successfully.

**Relationships:** Processing a notification can update the corresponding payment request, subscription request, vendor, or bank account enrollment record, depending on the notification type.

For background on configuring payment services for vendors, see [Vendor payment service options](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Vendor_payment_services_options) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Sandboxes
tags.description:
A sandbox is a copy of your production environment that you can use for testing or training without affecting your production data or configuration.

**When to use:** Use when you need an isolated environment to safely develop, test, or validate integrations, configurations, or workflows before deploying changes to production.

**Relationships:** Linked to the company configuration. You can use the [refresh](/intacct/apis/intacct/1/intacct-openapi/groups/company-configuration/tags/company_configuration_sandboxes/paths/refresh-company-config-sandbox) workflow, which updates the sandbox to reflect your latest production environment changes.

**Lifecycle context:** Sandboxes last for the duration of the billing cycle and can be refreshed up to four times annually. When you submit a sandbox creation request, the sandbox state is first `pending`. During the creation process, the sandbox state changes to `inProgress`. Should sandbox creation fail, the state changes to `failed`. After a sandbox is successfully created, its state changes from `inProgress` to `ready`. At this point you can log in to it from the Sandboxes page, update the sandbox, get its details, refresh it, or delete it. For more information, see [Sandboxes](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=About_sandboxes) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Transaction currencies
tags.description:
A transaction currency defines an ISO or custom currency that can be used in company transactions when multiple transaction currencies are enabled. Sage Intacct provides a list of ISO currencies with predefined properties, and you can create custom currencies with user-defined properties.

**When to use:** Use transaction currencies when configuring the currencies available for company transactions in a multi-currency company.

**Relationships:** Transactions use the configured transaction currencies to identify their currency.

**Lifecycle context:** Configure transaction currencies before using them in company transactions. ISO currency properties are predefined by Sage Intacct; custom currency properties are supplied when the custom currency is created.

For more information, see [Transaction currencies](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Adding_Editing_Viewing_Currency_Information) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Company preferences
tags.description:
Company preferences are the company-wide settings for legal information, contact details, branding, security, and localization.

**When to use:** Use to retrieve or update settings that apply across the entire company, such as legal name, address, branding, password policy, and date/time formats.

For more information, see [Company information](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Company_information) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Multi-entity preferences
tags.description:
Multi-entity preferences configure a multi-entity shared company, where each entity represents a separate tax identification or a separately secured, fully balancing set of books. Entities can represent divisions, franchises, affiliates, associations, locations, chapters, self-balancing funds, or subsidiaries, and share a chart of accounts.

**When to use:** Use when managing multiple base currencies, inter-entity processing, and entity-level transaction restrictions.

**Relationships:** Applies to the company's entities and can reference a journal for inter-entity credits.

**Lifecycle context:** Configured before transactions and reporting use the company's multi-entity settings.

For more information, see [Multi-entity companies](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_learn_about_me) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Consolidation preferences
tags.description:
Consolidation preferences configure how consolidations work in Sage Intacct, including domestic, global, and advanced ownership consolidation. Each consolidation subscription enables you to consolidate books in a multi-entity shared company.

**When to use:** Use to retrieve or select the consolidation subscription type based on your business needs.

For more information, read about [consolidation subscriptions](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Comparison_consolidation_options) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Advanced consolidation preferences
tags.description:
Advanced consolidation preferences configure company-wide settings for advanced ownership
consolidation, which uses ownership structures to enable multi-level consolidations and
automated non-controlling interest entries in a multi-entity company.

**When to use:** Use to set up or update the minority interest GL accounts and consolidating
location used when advanced ownership consolidation runs.

**Relationships:** Linked to the GL accounts and location used to record minority interest
and consolidated financial data.

For more information, see [Advanced ownership consolidations](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=aa_TOC_advanced_ownership_consolidations) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Order Entry preferences
tags.description:
Order Entry preferences manage settings for the Order Entry application, including transaction workflows, accounting, contacts, taxes, pricing, discounts, and item handling.

**When to use:** Use when retrieving or updating settings used by Order Entry transactions.

**Relationships:** Related to General Ledger accounts, Order Entry transactions, and drop-ship, buy-to-order, and document configuration preferences.

**Lifecycle context:** Configured before sales transactions use the application's workflow and posting settings.

For more information, see [Configure Order Entry](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Configuring_the_Order_Entry_Application) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Company_Configuration_Purchasing preferences
tags.description:
A Purchasing preference manages settings and preferences for the Purchasing application.

**When to use:** Use the Purchasing preference to review or update configuration settings for Purchasing transactions, approvals, automation, contacts, taxes, pricing, and related workflows.

**Relationships:** Purchasing preferences include settings for General Ledger accounts and users, and can reference Purchasing transaction automation, matching, and document configuration preferences.

For more information, see [Configure the Purchasing application](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Configuring_Purchase_Orders) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Consolidation_Consolidation books
tags.description:
Consolidation books define how to combine the financial and operational information within multi-entity companies. They specify the entities included in the consolidation, the method for translating foreign currency amounts, and other operational details. You can have multiple consolidation books to support different reporting requirements.

For more information, read about [consolidation books](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Book_setup_GC) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Consolidation_Consolidation entities
tags.description:
A consolidation entity represents an entity that is included in a consolidation book. Entities can be added to a consolidation book at any time, whereas they can only be removed before the first consolidation is run.      
A consolidation book either takes entities that perform their day-to-day operations in different accounting currencies and consolidates them into a single currency for reporting, or consolidates entities that are part of a corporate group structure with a single base currency.

For more information about consolidation books and entities, read about [setting up a consolidation book](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Book_setup_overview) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Consolidation_Consolidation elimination accounts
tags.description:
Elimination accounts reference the General Ledger (GL) accounts that you use for inter-entity auto-elimination in consolidation books. They post offsetting so that inter-entity transactions do not affect reporting in the consolidated book.

For more information, read about elimination accounts for [global consolidations](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Elimination_accounts_GC) and [domestic consolidations](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Elimination_accounts_tab_dc) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Consolidation_Consolidation override accounts
tags.description:
Override accounts are used to set up specific General Ledger (GL) accounts that require a different currency conversion method than the one defined for the overall consolidation book.

For more information, read about [accounts to override](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Accts_to_override_GC) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Consolidation_Consolidation adjustment journals
tags.description:
When you first create a consolidation book, Global or Domestic Consolidation creates the proposed journals to be used during consolidation. Consolidation journals are required for compliance, tax, or user-defined books. After you run a consolidation, journals can no longer be modified.

For more information, read about [journals for global consolidations](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Journals_tab_book_setup_GC) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Consolidation_Consolidation time periods
tags.description:
Time periods in consolidation represent standard months or company-defined accounting periods, including the first and last days of each period.

For more information, read about [time periods when running a consolidation](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Consolidating_Subsidiary_Data) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Consolidation_Consolidation run statuses
tags.description:
The consolidation run status represents the status of a consolidation process for a specific book, entity, and period. It is required to track the progress and outcome of a consolidation and provides information about whether the consolidation is in progress, successful, failed, or requires re-consolidation.

For more information, read about [running a consolidation](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Consolidating_Subsidiary_Data) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Consolidation_Consolidation ownership structures
tags.description:
Ownership structures define the hierarchical relationships between parent and child (subsidiary) entities in a consolidation. Advanced Ownership Consolidation uses ownership structures to automate combining your business activity across entities over time into a consolidation book.

For more information, read [about ownership structures](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Overview_Adv_Own_Cons) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Consolidation_Consolidation ownership structure periods
tags.description:
Ownership structure periods represent time-bound segments within an ownership structure used for consolidation in Sage Intacct. Each period encapsulates the relationships and details of parent and child entities during that specific timeframe.

For more information, read [about ownership structures](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Overview_Adv_Own_Cons) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Consolidation_Consolidation ownership entities
tags.description:
Ownership entities represent parent entities within an ownership structure, detailing their relationships with subsidiary entities and associated consolidation books. They must have at least one child entity in an active state, where the ownership percentage between parent and child is defined.

For more information, read about [setting up ownership structures](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=aa_TOC_aoc_setup_ownership_structures).

tags.name: Consolidation_Consolidation ownership subsidiary entities
tags.description:
Ownership subsidiary entities represent the child entities within an ownership structure used for consolidation purposes. They cannot exist without a parent entity and an ownership structure. These entities are part of a hierarchical framework that defines how ownership and control are distributed among various subsidiaries under a parent entity.

For more information, read about [setting up ownership structures](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=aa_TOC_aoc_setup_ownership_structures) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Construction_Project contracts
tags.description: Associate a project contract and its corresponding project contract lines with a project to capture a mix of billable details and include those details into your construction project billing.

tags.name: Construction_Project contract lines
tags.description: Project contract line define the products or services included in a project contract. Multiple lines on a contract allow for different types of billing (lump sum, progress, cost plus, T&M) for each line.

tags.name: Construction_Project contract line entries
tags.description: Use project contract line entries to add pricing to the project contract line at the appropriate workflow type.

tags.name: Construction_Project contract types
tags.description: Use project contract types to group or categorize project contract information for reporting purposes.

tags.name: Construction_Project contract line task maps
tags.description:
Project contract line task maps represent the relationship that links a construction project contract line to an associated project task. Only existing tasks within the project or an associated sub-project can be mapped to a project contract line. Create and maintain project contract line task maps from the owning [construction project contract line](/intacct/apis/intacct/1/intacct-openapi/groups/construction/groups/project-contracts/tags/construction_project-contract-lines) object. Construction subscription is required for this object.

For more information, read about [mapping time and material tasks to construction project contract lines](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Map_time_material_tasks_project_contract_lines) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

tags.name: Construction_Cost type observed percent completed
