addressSettings.description: Defines the address settings for check printing.

printAddress.description:
Indicates whether to print an address on checks:

  - `true` - Prints the address on checks.
  - `false` - Does not print the address on checks. Set to `false` if you don't want to include an address or when using pre-printed check stock that already includes the address.

addressToPrint.description:
Specifies the address to print on checks:

  - `company` - Uses the address set for the company.
  - `custom` - Uses the address defined in the `name` and `address` fields.

name.description: Specifies the company name to print on checks from this checking account if `addressToPrint` is set to `custom`.

address.description: Specifies the address to print on checks from this checking account if `addressToPrint` is set to `custom`.

addressLine1.description: First line of the street to print on qualifying checks.

addressLine2.description: Second line of the street to print on qualifying checks.

addressLine3.description: Third line of the street to print on qualifying checks.

city.description: City to print on qualifying checks.

state.description: State to print on qualifying checks.

postCode.description: Zip or postal code to print on qualifying checks.

country.description: Country to print on qualifying checks.

countryCode.description: ISO country code to print on qualifying checks. When ISO country codes are enabled for a company, both `country` and `countryCode` must be provided.

phone.description: Phone number to print on qualifying checks.

printLogo.description:
Indicates whether to print the company logo on qualifying checks. Requires a logo image file to be uploaded in Sage Intacct.

For more information, read about [adding logos to checks](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Check_logos) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

signatures.description:
Defines the uploaded signature images to print on qualifying checks for the account. By default, signatures are not included on blank or preprinted check stock. 

For more information, read about [check signatures](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Uploading_Your_Check_Signature) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

firstSignature.description: Image file name for the first signature.

limitForFirstSignatureAmount.description: Specifies the limit as an amount for printing the first signature on qualifying checks. The first signature is printed on checks for less than this amount, while a manual signature line is printed on checks for more than this amount, or when this field is `null`.

useSecondSignature.description: Indicates whether to include second signature on qualifying checks. Set to `false` to always show just one signature.

secondSignature.description: Image file name for the second signature.

limitForSecondSignatureAmount.description: Specifies the limit as an amount for printing the second signature on qualifying checks. The second signature is printed on checks for less than this this amount, while a manual signature line is printed on checks for more than this amount, or when this field is `null`. Applies when `useSecondSignature` is set to `true`.

thresholdForSecondSignatureAmount.description: Specifies the threshold as an amount for printing the second signature on qualifying checks. The second signature is printed on checks for more than this amount.

printSettings.description: Specifies the check printing settings for the account.

printOn.description:
Indicates the check stock to use for printing checks for the account:  

- `prePrintedCheckStock` - Uses check paper that is pre-printed with company information.
- `blankCheckStock` - Uses blank check paper.

nextCheckNumber.description: Specifies the starting check number to use when printing checks for the account, for example 1001. Check numbers increment by one for each succeeding check printed.

printingFormat.description:
Specifies the format to use when printing checks for the account:





  - `standard` - For pre-printed checks that already show the bank account number, routing number, and check numbers. Not available for CAD checking accounts.
  - `business` - Prints amounts in a font that makes alterations difficult (for security).
  - `highSecurity` - Same as `standard`, plus features that reduce fraud related to check washing, forgery, and copying. Not available for CAD checking accounts.
  - `cadCheck` - Prints checks with dates formatted for Canadian companies, can be used with CAD and USD checking accounts.
  - `jpmorganChaseBusiness` - For USD checking accounts with business checks where the Pay to the order of field is not above the Amount field but is next to the Vendor address.
  - `jpmorganChaseStandard` - For USD checking accounts with standard checks where the Pay to the order of field is not above the Amount field but is next to the Vendor address.

paperFormat.description:
Specifies the location for check printing on three-part forms: top, middle, or bottom panel. Pre-printed check stock is only compatible with the top and middle printing position.

Canadian check stock is only compatible with the top printing position.

printLineItems.description: Indicates whether to include additional fields in the non-remittance panel of checks. These fields include columns for the account, department, and location of each line item. A check can include up to 18 line items per page in either summary or detail mode.

printLocation.description:
Specifies the location information to include on checks:

  - `id` - Print the location identifier only in the location column.
  - `name` - Print the location name only in the location column.
  - `both`(default) - Print both the location identifier and the location name in the location column.

additionalText.description: Specifies additional text to print under the signatures.

numberOfChecksInPreview.description: Specifies the number of checks per page to preview before printing.

micrSettings.description:
Specifies the Magnetic Ink Character Recognition (MICR) settings. MICR format is a widely adopted bank standard for blank check stock, standardizing the appearance of the routing, account, and other numbers at the bottom of every check. Use these settings if your bank requires specific horizontal alignment of the account number on the MICR line on the printed check. 

For more information, read the [MICR printing guidelines](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=MICR_information_on_checks) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

accountNumberAlignment.description: Specifies how the bank account number is aligned on the MICR line.

accountNumberPositioning.description: Specifies the positioning of the bank account number on the MICR line, defined by the number of spaces added before or after the account number.

minCheckNumberLength.description: Specifies the required length for check numbers on the MICR line. Minimum check number length is six digits, shorter check numbers are left-padded with zeros.

regionalSettings.description: Specifies the regional settings for MICR.

printCode45.description: Indicates whether to print the transaction code 45 on the MICR line.

printUSFundsUnderCheckAmount.description: Indicates whether to print US funds under the check amount box for CPA member banks.

printOnUsSymbol.description: Indicates whether to print the ON-US symbol in front of the account number on the MICR line.

positionOfOnUsSymbol.description: Specifies the position of the ON-US symbol on the MICR line. To position the symbol before the checking account number, set to `position31` or `position32`.

department.description: Specifies the department to use for General Ledger (GL) posting (optional).

key.description: Unique key for the department.

href.description: URL endpoint for the department.

location.description: Specifies the location to use for General Ledger (GL) posting (optional).

key.description: Unique key for the location.

href.description: URL endpoint for the location.

ach.description:
Specifies the Automated Clearing House (ACH) details.

For more information, read about [setting up a checking account for ACH payments](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Bank_file_account_setup) in Sage Intacct Help Center.

enableACH.description: Indicates whether to to enable the account to make standard ACH or American Express ACH Payment Services payments.

bankId.description: Identifier for the bank, as specified in the ACH bank record.

companyName.description: Name of the company, as specified in the ACH bank record.

companyIdentification.description: Specifies the 10-digit identifier (including hyphens) for the company, as specified in the ACH bank record.

originatingFinancialInstitution.description: References the first eight digits of the routing number for the bank, as specified in the ACH bank record.

companyEntryDescription.description: Indicates optional text that can be included with ACH payments.

companyDiscretionaryData.description: Specifies additional information that can be included with ACH payments. Typically this will consist of codes (unique to each bank) that describe any special handling of entries.

useRecommendedSetup.description: Indicates whether to automatically generate the ACH payment file, with `serviceClassCode` set to `220` (credits only), and set up numbering sequences for standard ACH payments.

recordTypeCode.description: Indicates the record type code for ACH payments.

serviceClassCode.description: Specifies the service class code for ACH payments. Use `220` for payments (credits) only, or `200` for both credits and debits. If using `200`, then `useRecommendedSetup` must be `false`.

originatorStatusCode.description: Indicates the originator status code for ACH payments.

batchId.description: Identifies the number sequence that automatically numbers payment batches. The batch number must be 7-digits, with no prefixes or suffixes. Required if `useRecommendedSetup` is `false`.

traceNumberSequence.description: Identifies the number sequence that generates the trace number for ACH entries. The trace number is formed by concatenating the bank routing number with a 7-digit sequence number, and has no prefixes or suffixes. Required if `useRecommendedSetup` is `false`.

paymentNumberSequence.description: Identifies the number sequence that assigns a unique payment number to confirmed Accounts Payable (AP) payments. You can use the same number sequence specified in `traceNumberSequence`. Required if `useRecommendedSetup` is `false`.

useTraceNumber.description: Indicates whether to use the trace number as a payment (`useAsPayment`) or as a numbering sequence (`useNumberSequence`).

bankFile.description:
Specifies the bank file details for companies subscribed to Sage Cloud Services and enabled for bank file payments. A bank file is a standard file used by banks to make multiple payments, they enable your company to pay vendors using international checking accounts.

For more information, read about [setting up a checking account for bank file payments](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Bank_file_account_setup) in Sage Intacct Help Center.

enableBankFile.description: Indicates whether to enable bank file payments for checking accounts in supported countries.

bankFileFormat.description:
Specifies the bank file format of the bank associated with the checking account. 

For more information, read about [bank files](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Bank_file_payment) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

bankCode.description: Specifies the bank code for the bank associated with the checking account.

apcaNumber.description: Six-digit identifier for the company or individual, used by Australian banks to make direct payments.

bsbNumber.description: Six-digit identifier for an individual branch of a financial institution in Australia, expressed as two groups of three separated by a hyphen.

sunNumber.description: Unique identifier (optional) for organizations that collect payment with bank files. The service user number, together with the bank file, creates a record of the transaction. For HSBC customers only.

sortCode.description: Six-digit identifier for the UK bank and branch where the checking account is held, expressed as three groups of two separated by hyphens.

seedValue.description: Specifies the 32-character encryption key (seed value) issued by NedBank, used to generate and validate secure payment files.

userReference.description: Specifies the 10-character reference supplied by Standard Bank, this reference is used on bank statements.

clientCode.description: User code that identifies the client to Standard Bank.

serviceType.description: Indicates the type of Bulk Electronic Fund Transfer (BEFT) service to use.

processingDataCenterCode.description: Specifies the 5-digit identifier for the originating direct clearer.

debtorBankNumber.description: Identifier for the settlement institutional bank (processing bank).

branchTransitNumber.description: Branch transit number for the settlement institutional bank (processing bank).

returnAccountNumber.description: Specifies the return account number for the checking account.

messageIdPrefix.description: Specifies a 23-character identifier for each submitted payment file, specific to the Bank of Ireland SEPA bank file format, combining a customer-defined prefix with a system-generated 12-digit date/time stamp.

immediateDestinationId.description: Bank routing number for the institution receiving the payment file.

immediateOriginId.description: Bank routing number for the institution sending the payment file.

immediateOriginName.description: Name of the company sending the payment file.

immediateDestinationName.description: Name of the company receiving the payment file.

companyEntryDescription.description: Indicates optional text used to describe the transaction, for example, Payroll or Payables, to be included with payments.

companyName.description: Company name for the checking account.

paymentNumberSequence.description: Specifies the number sequence that generates a unique payment number for payment files uploaded to the bank. You can use the same number sequence specified in `traceNumberSequence`. Required if `useRecommendedSetup` is `false`.

fileIdSequence.description: Specifies the sequence used to identify payment files generated each calendar day. The first file generated for each calendar day starts with `A`. Each subsequent file increments alphabetically, then numerically, and resets at the start of the next calendar day.

addressLine1.description: First address line for the bank.

addressLine2.description: Second address line for the bank.

countryCode.description: ISO country code for the bank.

cloudDelivery.description: Specifies how generated bank files are delivered to cloud storage.

mode.description: Delivery mode for generated bank files.

href.description: Endpoint URL for the cloud storage.

key.description: Unique key for the rule set.

href.description: URL endpoint for the rule set.

restrictions.description:
Specifies the restriction type, along with the entities and locations allowed to use the checking account for making payments. 

For more information, read about [restricting a bank account](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Restrict_a_bank_account) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

restrictionType.description:
Specify which entities and/or locations can access and use the checking account.

- `unrestricted` (default) - the account is available to the top-level company and all entity-level locations.
- `rootOnly` - Only the top-level company of a multi-entity structure can access the account.
- `restricted` - Only specified locations, location groups, departments, or department groups can access the account.

locations.description: List of locations that can access the checking account when `restrictionType` is set to `restricted`.

When a bank fee is reversed, the original `posted` transaction immediately enters the `reversal` state and transitions to the `reversed` state once the reversal date is reached. When you reverse a bank fee, a corresponding reversal transaction is also created in the `reversal` state. The state of this reversal transaction remains unchanged after creation.

You can also create advance payments when no invoices match the bank transactions, or save the payment as draft if you are not ready to post the payment.

paymentApplicationMethod.description:
Determines the order in which invoices are matched and applied to a received payment:

* `matchToOpenAmount` - Matches the payment to invoices with an open amount equal to the payment amount.
* `oldestInvoiceFirst` - Applies the payment to the oldest outstanding invoices first.
* `mostRecentInvoiceFirst` - Applies the payment to the most recent outstanding invoices first.
* `largestOpenAmountFirst` - Applies the payment to invoices with the largest open amounts first.
* `smallestOpenAmountFirst` - Applies the payment to invoices with the smallest open amounts first.
* `createAdvance` - Creates an advance payment when no invoices match the bank transactions. Applies when `createAdvances` is set to `true`.

* The name of a field in the object that you are querying, such as `id`.
* The name of a field in a related object, using the form `relatedObjectName.fieldName`, such as `vendor.id`.
* The result of an aggregate function run against the values in the returned objects. Use the form `function:fieldName`, such as `min:startDate` to return the earliest starting date. Valid function names are:

    * `avg`
    * `sum`
    * `min`
    * `max`

* The result of an aggregate function run against the values in related objects, using the form `function:relatedObjectName.fieldName`, such as `max:vendor.creditLimit`. The same functions are supported as for object fields.

Field value is not within the given range. For date fields, you can use these macro values that are relative to the current date or the `asOfDate` in [`filterParameters`](#filterParameters), if set:
  • today
  • currentWeek
  • currentMonth
  • currentQuarter
  • currentYear
  • yesterday
  • lastWeek
  • priorMonth
  • priorQuarter
  • priorYear
These are most useful for queries that you want to save and use repeatedly, such as for views or reports. Just change the `asOfDate` each time to retrieve the same data set for different time periods.

fixedPrefix.description: Characters that appear before the primary sequence.

prefixSeparator.description: Characters to use between the prefix and the auto-generated sequence.

fixedSuffix.description: Characters that appear after the primary sequence.

suffixSeparator.description: Characters to use between the auto-generated sequence and the suffix.

startingNumber.description: For `numeric` sequences, the starting number. Required when `type` is `numeric`.

Use the `fiscalYears` array to configure the next number or alpha values used to generate sequences for the fiscal years. If the configuration for a fiscal year is missing then it will be generated by the system when the first sequence is generated. The next number or alpha values will be taken from the base start values.

- `none` Do not automatically insert the fiscal year into the document sequence.
- `prefix` Use the fiscal year and the rollover `separator` as a prefix to the document sequence.
- `suffix` Append the rollover `separator` and the fiscal year as a suffix to the document sequence.

objects.company-config.email-template.description: A legacy email template lists the templates used to send electronic order entry transactions and identifies the person who created each template.

description.example: Used to send monthly sales invoices.

sender.description: Sender information for the email template.

replyTo.description: Legacy derived reply-to email address for the template. This value is retained for backward compatibility and is populated from the underlying approved sender email configuration.

senderName.description: Display name used for the sender on the email template.

approvedSenderEmailId.description: Identifier for the approved sender email entry. The reply-to address is automatically populated from the referenced entry. Required when `useOwnEmailAddress` is `false` or not set. This value is `null` when `useOwnEmailAddress` is `true`.

useOwnEmailAddress.description: Indicates whether the sending user's own email address is used as the reply-to address for the template. When `true`, `approvedSenderEmailId` is not required. When `false` or unset, `approvedSenderEmailId` is required.

recipients.description: Recipient information for the email template. You can put one or more email addresses in each field (use commas to separate multiple addresses), or you can use one or more [merge fields](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Email_merge_fields) in each field. The merge fields are replaced with the actual email addresses when the email is sent.

to.description: The primary recipients of the email.

cc.description: Recipients who should receive a courtesy copy of the email.

bcc.description: Recipients who should receive a copy of the email but not be visible to other recipients.

subject.description: Combination of text and merge fields as desired to create an informative subject line.

body.description: Combination of text, merge fields, and HTML markup as desired to create and customize the message.

logo.description: Logo information for the email template. The logo is included in the email if the `isLogoIncluded` property is set to `true`.

isLogoIncluded.description: Indicates whether to include the logo image file identified on the Company Information page in the email template.

verticalPosition.description: Vertical logo position. Sets whether the logo should appear at the `top` or `bottom` of the email.

horizontalPosition.description: Horizontal logo position. Sets whether the logo should appear on the `left` or `right` side of the email.

includeTxnAttachments.description: Indicates whether to include documents attached to the transaction, such as receipts, in emails sent from transactions. Attachments are emailed in the format in which they were attached to the transaction. For example, if you attached a TXT file, the file is sent as a TXT file.

includeProjectInvoiceTxnAttachments.description: Indicates whether to include all source document attachments linked to a project invoice when emailing the invoice. Attachments are emailed in the format in which they were attached to the transaction. For example, if you attached a TXT file, the file is sent as a TXT file.

templateType.description: The type of transaction to use this email template for. This value determines the merge fields available for use in the subject and body of the email template.

budgetVarianceNotification.description: Notification configuration for budget variance email.

notificationType.description: This field specifies the condition under which a notification is triggered for Budget vs Actuals analysis. This value is only applicable when the `templateType` is set to `budgetVariance`.

recipients.description: This field is used to identify the audience for Budget vs Actuals analysis. This value is only applicable when the templateType is set to budgetVariance.

useSendersPreferredDateFormat.description: Indicates whether dates in the email use the date format in the sender's user preference setting.

combineAttachmentsToZip.description:
Combine attachments into a zip file.

- `none` - Do not combine attachments into a zip file.
- `single` - Combine attachments into a single zip file.
- `expenseType` - Combine attachments into a single zip file by expense type.

objects.company-config.user.description: A user is an individual who has access to Sage Intacct.

key.description: System-assigned unique key for the user. This key identifies the user in URLs or JSON bodies for all operations on the user.

userType.description: User type that determines the _maximum_ set of features and activities the user can access and perform in Intacct. The user's permissions also determine what they can do. For more information, see [User types](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=About_user_types).

adminPrivileges.description:
Level of administrator privileges for the user.

* `off` - No admin privileges
* `full` - Complete administration privileges including the ability to create other full administrators and use Platform Services features. Requires that `userType` is set to `business`.
* `limited` - All administration privileges, except for the previously mentioned items.  Requires that `userType` is set to `business`.

status.description:
Current status of the user.

- `active` - The user can log in and access Intacct.
- `inactive` -  Hides the user from lists throughout Intacct but retains the user information in the system. Cannot be used when creating a new user.
- `lockedOut` - Set by Intacct due to too many failed login attempts, or by an administrator to prevent the user from logging in. The user cannot log in until an administrator sets the status to `active`.

webServices.description: Web Services access settings for the user.

isEnabled.description: Indicates whether the user is allowed to use Web Services. Set to `true` to allow Web Services use.

isRestricted.description: Indicates whether the user is restricted to Web Services only. When set to `true`, the user cannot log in to the Sage Intacct user interface.

neverExpires.description: Indicates whether the user's password is set to never expire. Set to `true` to prevent the password from expiring. Use this setting only for Web Services API users.

requiresReset.description: Indicates whether to trigger the password reset flow for the user. Set to `true` to trigger the flow.

disablePassword.description: Indicates whether password requirements are disabled for the user.

sso.description: Single sign-on settings for the user.

isSSOEnabled.description: Indicates whether single sign-on is enabled for the user.

entityAccess.description: Entity-level access restrictions for the user.

allowUnrestrictedAccess.description: Indicates whether the user can access all entities in the company. Set to `false` to restrict the user to the entities listed in the `entities` array.

allowTopLevelAccess.description: Indicates whether the user can access the top-level entity in the company. It's a best practice to enable top-level access for users restricted to a single entity in a multi-entity shared company.

productAccess.description:
Suite application IDs for products that the user can access. Each suite application must be enabled in
the Suites configuration and assigned to the company before it can be assigned to a user.
`SI_FINANCIALS` is required when `userType` is `business`.

Examples include `SI_FINANCIALS`, `SI_PLANNING_ACCELERATE`, and `SI_CONSTRUCTION_MANAGEMENT`.

trustedDevices.description: Whether to recognize trusted devices for the user-- always, never, or use the company setting.

isChatterDisabled.description: Indicates whether the Intacct Collaborate feature is disabled for the user.

hideOtherDepartmentTransactions.description: Indicates whether to hide transactions from the user that do not belong to the departments listed in the `departments` array.

objects.company-config.txn-currency.description: A transaction currency represents both ISO and custom currencies that can be used in company transactions where multiple transaction currencies are enabled.

key.description: System-assigned unique key for the transaction currency.

id.description:
Unique ID for the transaction currency. When `currencyType` is set to `iso`, choose a valid ISO currency code from this list:

('USD','AED','AFN','ALL','AMD','ANG','AOA','ARS','AUD','AWG','AZN','BAM','BBD','BDT','BGN','BHD','BIF','BMD','BND','BOB','BRL','BSD','BTN','BWP','BYN','BYR','BZD','CAD','CDF','CHF','CLP','CNY','COP','CRC','CUC','CUP','CVE','CZK','DJF','DKK','DOP','DZD','EGP','ERN','ETB','EUR','FJD','**P','GBP','GEL','GHS','GIP','GMD','GNF','GTQ','GYD','HKD','HNL','HRK','HTG','HUF','IDR','ILS','INR','IQD','IRR','ISK','JMD','JOD','JPY','KES','KGS','KHR','KMF','KPW','KRW','KWD','KYD','KZT','LAK','LBP','LKR','LRD','LSL','LYD','MAD','MDL','MGA','MKD','MMK','MNT','MOP','MRO','MUR','MVR','MWK','MXN','MYR','MZN','NAD','NGN','NIO','NOK','NPR','NZD','OMR','PAB','PEN','PGK','PHP','PKR','PLN','PYG','QAR','RON','RSD','RUB','RWF','SAR','SBD','SCR','SDG','SEK','SGD','SHP','SLL','SOS','SRD','STD','SVC','SYP','SZL','THB','TJS','TMT','TND','TOP','TRY','TTD','TWD','TZS','UAH','UGX','UYU','UZS','VEF','VES','VND','VUV','WST','XAF','XCD','XOF','XPF','YER','ZAR','ZMW','ZWL')

href.description: URL endpoint for the transaction currency.

currencyType.description:
Type of the transaction currency:

* `iso` - An ISO currency with predefined properties. The `id` field must be set to a valid ISO currency code, and the other properties will be automatically populated based on the selected ISO currency.
* `custom` - A user-defined currency with custom properties, provide values for the other properties to define the custom currency.

name.description: Name of the transaction currency. Required when `currencyType` is set to `custom`.

isoCode.description: Official ISO-4217 numeric code for the transaction currency. Applies only when `currencyType` is set to `iso`. The value is automatically populated based on the selected ISO currency code in the `id` field. For example, if `id` is set to `GBP`, the `isoCode` is automatically populated with `826`.

currencyFormat.description: Format of the transaction currency. Required when `currencyType` is set to `custom`.

unit.description: Indicates the major unit of currency, such as dollars, pounds, or yen. Required when `currencyType` is set to `custom`.

subUnit.description: Indicates the sub-unit of currency, such as cents, pence, or centavos. Required when `currencyType` is set to `custom`.

symbol.description: Specifies the standard currency symbol, such as $, £, €, or ¥. Required when `currencyType` is set to `custom`.

thousandSeparator.description: Indicates the symbol used as the thousand separator, such as a comma or period. This has no mathematical impact, but helps the reader distinguish large values. Required when `currencyType` is set to `custom`.

decimalSeparator.description: Indicates the symbol used to separate the main units from the subunits, such as a period or comma. Required when `currencyType` is set to `custom`.

alignment.description: Indicates whether the currency symbol is displayed to the left or the right of the number. Required when `currencyType` is set to `custom`.

objects.company-config.multi-entity-pref.description: Multi-entity preferences configure consolidations in Sage Intacct for multi-entity companies.

key.description: System-assigned unique key for the multi-entity preference.

enableMultipleBaseCurrency.description:
Indicates whether multiple base currencies are enabled for entities within the company. When set to `true`, you can set up a separate base currency, or operating and reporting currency, for each entity in your company. When `false`, all entities in the company share the same base currency. Applies when multi-currency management is enabled in the General Ledger.

For more information, read about [enabling multiple base currencies](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Enable_multi_base_currency) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

approvalCurrency.description: Specifies the approval currency used to evaluate transaction approval thresholds for purchase transactions and expense reports.

isForm1099.description:
Indicates whether 1099 forms are issued using entity-level information instead of top-level company information. When `true` Sage Intacct prints the 1099 forms using the legal and tax details defined for each entity.

For more information, read about [printing 1099 forms for multi-entity companies](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=ME_company_and_1099s) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

disableEntitySlideIn.description: Indicates whether access is restricted to the top-level company only. When `true`, users can only access the top-level company and cannot access or navigate to individual entities. Applies only to multi-entity companies with a single base currency.

restrictSubledgerTxnToEntity.description: Indicates whether to restrict subledger transactions to the entity level only. When `true`, users can only enter subledger transactions at the entity level.

restrictGLTxnToEntity.description: Indicates whether to restrict General Ledger transactions to the entity level only. When `true`, users can only enter General Ledger transactions at the entity level.

enableCustomerRestrictions.description: Indicates whether to restrict which locations and departments are available to each top-level customer. When set to `true`, you can restrict the locations and departments for each top-level customer.

enableVendorRestrictions.description: Indicates whether to restrict which locations and departments are available to each top-level vendor. When set to `true`, you can restrict the locations and departments for each top-level vendor.

enableCheckingAccountRestrictions.description: Indicates whether to restrict which locations and departments can work with each checking account. When set to `true`, you can restrict the locations and departments for each checking account.

enableSavingsAccountRestrictions.description: Indicates whether to restrict which locations and departments can work with each savings account. When set to `true`, you can restrict the locations and departments for each savings account.

enableAffiliateEntity.description:
Indicates whether to use the affiliate entity dimension in the company. When set to `true`, you can use the affiliate entity dimension for inter-entity transactions and reporting.

For more information, read about [the affiliate entity standard dimension](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=TOC_affiliate_entity_dimension) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

interEntityAccountMappingPlan.description:
Specifies the type of inter-entity account mapping:
* `basic`: Use only one set of inter-entity accounts per entity.
* `advanced`: Define separate sets of inter-entity accounts for each entity relationship, or entity pair.

limitAPCredit.description: Indicates whether to limit Accounts Payable (AP) credits to the owning entity.When set to `true`, credits are applied only to bills owned by the same entity as the credit. When `false`, credits are applied to bills owned by the same entity first, and then to bills owned by other entities, starting with the oldest bill.

limitARCredit.description: Indicates whether to limit Accounts Receivable (AR) credits to the owning entity. When set to `true`, credits are applied only to invoices owned by the same entity as the credit. When `false`, credits are applied to invoices owned by the same entity first, and then to invoices owned by other entities, starting with the oldest invoice.

isModuleConfigured.description: Indicates whether the multi-entity module has been configured for use in the company.

interEntityTxns.description: Use these settings to control how Sage Intacct records transactions that involve two or more entities.

enableForJournalEntry.description: Indicates whether to enable inter-entity transactions for journal entries. When set to `true`, Sage Intacct automatically creates offsetting entries for journal entries that involve two or more entities. When `false`, all balancing line items must be entered manually.

manuallyBalanceSubledgerTxns.description:
Indicates whether to disable automatic tracking of Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR) inter-entity subledger transactions.

When set to `true`, inter-entity AP and AR subledger transactions must be balanced manually, you do not need to specify a `creditsJournal`. When `false`, Sage Intacct automatically creates offsetting journal entries to track inter-entity AP and AR subledger transactions.

manuallyBalanceSubledgerCredits.description:
Indicates whether to disable automatic recording of Accounts Payable (AP) and Accounts Receivable (AR) inter-entity credits, adjustments, and advances.

When set to `true`, inter-entity AP and AR credits must be balanced manually, you do not need to specify a `creditsJournal`. When `false`, Sage Intacct automatically creates offsetting journal entries to track inter-entity AP and AR credits, adjustments, and advances.

creditsJournal.description: Specifies the journal to use when posting inter-entity credit bills or invoices to AP or AR, respectively. This journal is used when credits are applied to AR invoices or AP bills that generate an inter-entity transaction (IET) with no source payment record.

key.description: Unique key for the credits journal.

href.description: URL endpoint for the credits journal.

balanceJournalEntryBy.description: Indicates whether to enforce journal entry balancing by location or entity. If you choose not to enable inter-entity transactions, you can enforce journal entry balancing by location instead of entity.

objects.company-config.order-entry-prefe.description: Order Entry preferences manage settings and preferences for the Order Entry application.

key.description: System-assigned unique key for the Order Entry preference. This value must be set to `setup` for this object.

installedWorkflow.description: The workflow that specifies transaction definitions to determine how Order Entry transactions are routed through your company's financial system.

accountingPreferences.description: Applicable offset account information for Order Entry transactions in a simplified company setup.

offsetGLAccount.description: The default General Ledger (GL) account to use for the credit side of Order Entry transactions (offset account).

key.description: Unique key for the offset GL account.

id.description: ID for the offset GL account.

name.description: Name for the offset GL account.

href.description: URL endpoint for the offset GL account.

unbilledGLAccount.description: The default unbilled account to use in unbilled workflows.

key.description: Unique key for the unbilled GL account.

id.description: ID for the unbilled GL account.

name.description: Name for the unbilled GL account.

href.description: URL endpoint for the unbilled GL account.

enableForeignCurrency.description: For multi-currency companies, indicates whether multiple currencies are used in Order Entry transactions.

enableFuturePostingRestriction.description: Indicates whether Order Entry inherits the thresholds configured for the General Ledger and Accounts Payable for handling transactions with a future GL posting date.

enableDraftMode.description: Indicates whether transactions can be saved as drafts to finish and post later. This setting does not apply to recurring transactions.

omitMarkDraftPrintedTxn.description: Indicates whether draft transactions are left unflagged as printed after any print or email option is used.

displayPaymentStatus.description: Indicates whether payment details are accessible directly for Order Entry transactions. Applies only to transactions that post to Accounts Payable.

enableAdvanceTxnProcessing.description:
Indicates whether advanced transaction processing is enabled for Order Entry transactions, providing these features:
- Convert two or more transactions into one transaction.
- Convert line items from different transactions into one transaction.
- Process two or more transactions at a time.

enableBillToContactAtLine.description: Indicates whether you can add a bill-to contact on contract invoice line items. This applies to Contracts data only.

enableShipToContactAtLine.description: Indicates whether you can add a ship-to contact on a transaction line item. A line-level ship-to contact is used to calculate tax at the line level; taxes are always calculated at the line level based on a ship-to contact. Depending on the transaction definition configuration, you can change the ship-to contact at the line level. You can also specify multiple ship-to addresses on one sales transaction for printing sales documents. A line-level ship-to contact for tax calculation applies only to Avalara and Advanced Tax users.

enableInterEntityCOGSPostings.description: For sales transactions that use inventory from another entity, indicates whether the value of the sold inventory is recorded in the General Ledger. When the sales transaction is posted, journal entries for inter-entity receivables and payables are automatically created for cost of goods sold (COGS).

useLineItemDimensionsInSubtotal.description: For top-level transactions in a multi-entity environment, indicates whether dimension values enabled for line items are used as the dimension values in subtotal lines. If `editDimensionInSubtotal` is also `true`, the dimension values from the line items override any dimension values enabled for subtotal lines.

editDimensionInSubtotal.description: For top-level transactions in a multi-entity environment, indicates whether dimension values can be specified in subtotal lines. If `useLineItemDimensionsInSubtotal` is also `true`, the dimension values from the line items override any dimension values enabled for subtotal lines.

editLocationDepartmentInSubtotal.description: When `editDimensionInSubtotal` is `true`, indicates whether users can select location and department values in subtotal lines at the top level in a multi-entity company.

distributeDimensions.description: For multi-entity companies and entity-level users, indicates whether dimensions are distributed across subtotal lines, including proportional distributions. For custom reports for subtotal details, the subtotal information for entity-level transactions is included.

enablePriceConversion.description: Indicates whether price, instead of quantity (the default), can be selected as a conversion option for non-inventory line items on orders and invoices.

overrideDefaultTxnConversionType.description: For non-inventory items, indicates whether the default conversion type can be changed to price on orders and invoices.

constructionPreferences.description: Preferences applicable for construction enabled companies.

prefillConversionZero.description: Indicates whether 0 (zero) prefills the line price or quantity, depending on the conversion type, when converting a document instead of converting the remaining amount.

includeFullyConvertedLines.description: Indicates whether fully converted lines are included during conversion.

enableReverseConversions.description: Indicates whether reverse conversions are enabled.

senderEmailProfile.description:
Specifies the source for adding contact details to emails with attached transactions (name, email address, and phone number).
- `userProfile` - Use the sender email details from user profile, if it exists, else use the company email.
- `contactProfile` - Use the sender email details from the company profile.

contactsInTxn.description:
Determines whether to include all contacts or only contacts related to customer in transaction for pay-to, return-to, or deliver-to contacts.
- `all` - Include all contacts in transaction dropdown lists.
- `vendorContacts` - Restrict the contacts that are included in transaction dropdown lists to the contacts that are associated with the selected customer.

taxPreferences.description: Tax preferences for Order Entry transactions.

enableAdvancedTax.description:
Indicates whether Advanced Tax is the tax calculation method for Order Entry transactions.
- Set to `true` if your company does not have a Taxes application subscription. This option enables Advanced Tax as the tax calculation method. Create tax details, tax schedules, and tax schedule maps to define the tax mapping Sage Intacct uses to calculate taxes in transactions.
- Set to `false` if you have enabled Avalara AvaTax or plan to use Simple Tax. Advanced Tax is not compatible with either of these other tax calculation methods.
- If your company has a Taxes application subscription, this field is set to `true` and cannot be changed. You can create an Advanced Tax solution and assign it to the applicable entities.

enableSubtotalTemplates.description: Indicates whether templates are used to populate subtotals in transaction definitions. You can configure different entities to use different subtotals.

overrideTaxScheduleOnLine.description: Indicates whether the tax entry level can be overridden for sales orders.

priceAndDiscountPreferences.description: Price and discount preferences for Order Entry transactions.

enableSuggestedPriceDiscount.description: Indicates whether a discount percentage can be added to Order Entry line items to apply custom discounts.

enablePriceSchedule.description: Indicates whether price schedules are enabled for Order Entry transactions. You can then apply a price schedule associated with a customer to that customer?s Order Entry transactions.

enableCustomerPriceLists.description: Indicates whether customer price lists are enabled for Order Entry transactions. You can assign price lists to specific customers. When assigned, a customer price list overrides the price list associated with the transaction definition for the Order Entry transaction.

enableFixedCustomerDiscount.description: Indicates whether fixed customer discounts are enabled for Order Entry transactions. You can apply the fixed or blanket discount percentage for a customer to that customer?s Order Entry transactions.

itemPrecision.description: Determines the number of decimal places used for unit price and cost.

enableStartAndEndDate.description: Indicates whether contract or subscription items are used. When enabled, Intacct adds a Contract tab to the Item Information page so you can define the contract period for an item. You can define the contract period, such as a 12-month subscription period, and add the item to an order with its actual start and end dates.

enableKit.description: Indicates whether individual components can be grouped, built, and invoiced as a single item. For example, you can build a group of computer components into a computer that you sell and invoice as a single item.

preventNegativeInventory.description: Indicates whether saving Order Entry or Inventory Control transactions that create negative inventory for items is prevented. Set to `true` to prevent saving transactions that would make the quantity on hand negative at all warehouses; Sage Intacct issues a warning message instead. Set to `false` to permit transactions that make the quantity on hand negative.

disableQuantityChange.description: Indicates whether users are prevented from making certain changes during the workflow, such as increasing a line item quantity or adding line items. When `true`, users can still decrease quantities and delete line items.

enableAdvanceWorkflow.description: Indicates whether advanced workflow is enabled for Order Entry transactions. When `true`, users can set up different transaction definitions for different types of Order Entry transactions.

doNotValidateLinesBeforeDeleting.description: Indicates whether line references between change order documents are not validated before deletion. Set to `false` to validate whether a line reference exists; line references determine the order in which you can delete change orders.

href.description: URL endpoint for the Order Entry preference.

enableDropShip.description: For a company with Order Entry and Purchasing subscriptions, indicates whether a drop-ship workflow is enabled. When enabled, the system can automatically create Purchasing transactions for sales transaction line items selected for drop ship.

dropShipLines.description: Details of the drop ship preference.

enableBuyToOrder.description: For a company with Order Entry and Purchasing subscriptions, indicates whether a buy-to-order workflow is enabled. When enabled, the system can automatically create Purchasing transactions for sales transaction line items selected for buy to order.

buyToOrderLines.description: Details of the buy to order preference.

documentConfigurationLines.description: Details of the document configuration preference.

objects.purchasing.txn-match-tolerance-p.description: With match tolerances, Sage Intacct automatically compares the quantities and unit prices when you convert from one Purchasing transaction to the next. If the quantity or unit price in any line item is not within the tolerance range you set, Sage Intacct flags the draft or converted transaction with an exception.

key.description: System-assigned key for the transaction match tolerance preference.

id.description: System-assigned ID for the transaction match tolerance preference.

txnDefinitionToValidate.description:
Specifies a transaction definition to validate. When a source transaction is converted to a new transaction with this transaction definition, the new transaction is flagged as an exception if either, or both, of the following are true: 
- The quantity for a line varies from the quantity in the converted-from transaction by more than the percent specified in the `quantityTolerance` field - if either under or over.
- The unit price for a line varies from the unit price in the converted-from transaction by more than the percent specified in the `priceTolerance` field - if either under or over.

key.description: Unique key for the transaction definition.

id.description: Unique ID for the transaction definition.

name.description: Unique name for the transaction definition.

href.description: URL endpoint for the transaction definition.

quantityTolerance.description: The percent variance in quantity (over or under) that triggers the converted-to transaction to be flagged with an exception. The variance is calculated based on the difference in quantity in the source transaction and the transaction being converted to.

priceTolerance.description: The percent variance in unit price (over or under) that triggers the converted-to transaction to be flagged with an exception. The variance is calculated based on the difference in unit price in the source transaction and the transaction being converted to.

href.description: URL endpoint for the transaction match tolerance preference.

objects.purchasing.txn-automation-prefer.description:
AP automation with Purchasing allows you to define the purchasing transactions to automate. With automation, purchasing documents no longer need to be manually added and converted. 
Instead, Sage Intacct creates incoming transactions from uploaded or emailed vendor invoice documents.

id.description: System-assigned ID for the transaction automation preference.

entity.description:
Entity where the transaction automation is used. Transaction automation set up at the top level applies to all entities. 
Transaction automation set up for a specific entity overrides any top-level transaction automation.

key.description: Unique key for the entity.

href.description: URL endpoint for the entity.

sourceDocumentType.description:
When automating transactions with document matching, the type of transaction definition that you want Sage Intacct to match the draft transaction to.
An example of a source transaction definition is a purchase order.

id.description: Unique ID for the transaction definition.

name.description: Unique name for the transaction definition.

href.description: URL endpoint for the transaction definition.

targetDocumentType.description:
The transaction definition that you want Sage Intacct to use when creating a draft transaction from an uploaded or emailed document.
An example of a target transaction definition is a vendor invoice.

key.description: Unique key for the transaction definition.

id.description: Unique ID for the transaction definition.

name.description: Unique name for the transaction definition.

AP automation with Purchasing allows you to define the purchasing transactions to automate. With transaction automation, purchasing documents no longer need to be manually added and converted.

objects.purchasing.document-configuratio.description: Use this object to provide additional configuration information about transaction definitions.

key.description: System-assigned key for the document configuration preference.

id.description: System-assigned ID for the document configuration preference.

id.description: Unique ID for the transaction definition.

name.description: Unique name for the transaction definition.

summaryFrequency.description:
Set the frequency at which you want to post summaries of this document type.
- eachDocument - Do not summarize multiple transactions, and instead process each transaction separately as it is saved.
- daily - Summarize transactions by day. All transactions for the same day are summarized into a single journal entry.
- monthly - Summarize transactions by month. All transactions for the same month are summarized into a single journal entry.

additionalPostingJournal.description:
For transaction definitions that are configured for additional posting to the GL, specifies the journal to which to post the additional GL journal entries.
Posting additional GL entries is typically used when a previous transaction in the workflow posted to the GL in a user-defined book.

key.description: Unique key for the journal.

name.description: Name or title of the journal.

href.description: URL endpoint for the journal.

purchasingJournal.description: For transaction definitions that are configured to post directly to the GL, specifies the journal to which to post journal entries related to purchasing. You can assign a user-defined journal if the corresponding transaction definition has the `postToGL` field set to `true`.

key.description: Unique key for the journal.

name.description: Name or title of the journal.

href.description: URL endpoint for the journal.

emailTemplate.description:
Specifies the custom email template that will be the default template when a user chooses to send an email from this transaction type.

Note that email templates associated with a vendor will override this email template setting for transactions for that vendor.

key.description: Unique key for the email template.

id.description: Unique ID for the email template.

objects.company-config.purchasing-prefer.description: Purchasing preferences define settings for the Purchasing application.

key.description: System-assigned unique key for the Purchasing preference. This value must be `setup`.

installedWorkflow.description: Workflow that specifies the transaction definitions used to route Purchasing transactions through your company's financial system.

accountingPreferences.description: Offset account information for Purchasing transactions in a simplified company setup.

offsetGLAccount.description: Default Accounts Payable (AP) account for the credit side of Purchasing transactions (offset account).

key.description: System-assigned unique key for the offset GL account.

id.description: ID for the offset GL account.

name.description: Name of the offset GL account.

href.description: URL endpoint for the offset GL account.

key.description: System-assigned unique key for the unbilled GL account.

id.description: ID for the unbilled GL account.

name.description: Name of the unbilled GL account.

href.description: URL endpoint for the unbilled GL account.

enableForeignCurrency.description: Indicates whether Purchasing transactions use multiple currencies in multi-currency companies.

enableFuturePostingRestriction.description: Indicates whether Purchasing inherits the thresholds configured for General Ledger and Accounts Payable when handling transactions with a future GL posting date.

enableDraftMode.description: Indicates whether users can save transactions as drafts to finish and post later. This setting does not apply to recurring transactions.

restrictEmployeeToPurchasing.description:
Indicates whether access to Purchasing transactions is restricted for employee users:
- When `true`, employee users can only access the Purchasing transactions that they created.
- When `false`, employee users can access all Purchasing transactions that have a template type set to `quote`.

displayPaymentStatus.description: Indicates whether users can access payment details for Purchasing transactions directly. Applies only to transactions that post to Accounts Payable.

enableAdvanceTxnProcessing.description:
Indicates whether advanced transaction processing is enabled for Purchasing transactions, providing access to these features:
- Convert two or more transactions into one transaction.
- Convert line items from different transactions into one transaction.
- Process two or more transactions at a time.

deliverToContactPreferences.description:
Use deliver-to contacts on Purchasing transactions to:
- Calculate tax using the contact that corresponds to where your company will take possession of products or services and optionally calculate line-level tax subtotals for different deliver-to contacts. Only applicable to Avalara and Advanced Tax.
- Specify multiple delivery addresses on a single Purchasing transaction for use when printing Purchasing documents.

deliverToHeaderLevelContact.description: Indicates whether users can set a default deliver-to contact at the header level of a Purchasing transaction.

deliverToContact.description: Deliver-to contact for Purchasing transactions when `deliverToHeaderLevelContact` is `true`.

key.description: System-assigned unique key for the deliver-to contact.

href.description: URL endpoint for the deliver-to contact.

deliverToLineLevelContact.description: Indicates whether different deliver-to contacts can be set for line items in a Purchasing transaction. Enabling line-level deliver-to contacts also enables line-level subtotals.

postAdditionsInTxnCurrency.description:
Indicates whether additional postings for multi-currency companies use the transaction currency instead of the base currency.
Posting in the transaction currency ensures that journal entries are consistently recorded for all posted transactions in compliance with the rules for multi-currency transaction posting. The transaction currency is converted to the base currency using the exchange rate in effect when transactions are posted.

enableMatchTolerances.description:
Indicates whether match tolerances are enabled. Match tolerances validate the percent tolerance for quantity and unit price when converting a source transaction to the transaction being validated. Sage Intacct flags transaction lines as exceptions when the quantity, unit price, or both are higher or lower than the percent tolerance.
Manage the transaction definitions to validate and the percent tolerances for quantity and unit price using the `purchasing/match-tolerance-setup` object.

matchTolerancesGLAccount.description:
Match tolerance GL account. When `enableMatchTolerances` is `true`, the variance posts to this account.
When this value is `null`, the variance posts according to the account mapping in the transaction definition.

key.description: System-assigned unique key for the match tolerance GL account.

id.description: ID for the match tolerance GL account.

name.description: Name of the match tolerance GL account.

href.description: URL endpoint for the match tolerance GL account.

useLineItemDimensionsInSubtotal.description:
For top-level transactions in a multi-entity environment, this setting indicates whether dimension values specified for line items are used as the dimension values in subtotal lines.
If `editDimensionInSubtotal` is also `true`, the dimension values from line items override any dimension values specified for subtotal lines.

editDimensionInSubtotal.description:
For top-level transactions in a multi-entity environment, this setting indicates whether dimension values can be specified in transaction subtotal lines.
If `useLineItemDimensionsInSubtotal` is also `true`, the dimension values from line items override any dimension values specified for subtotal lines.

editLocationDepartmentInSubtotal.description: For top-level transactions in a multi-entity company, this setting indicates whether location and department values can be specified in subtotal lines when `allowEditDimensionInSubtotal` is `true`.

distributeDimensions.description:
For entity-level users in multi-entity companies, this setting indicates whether dimensions are distributed across subtotal lines, including proportional distributions.
When you run custom reports for subtotal details, subtotal information for entity-level transactions is included.

enablePriceConversion.description: Indicates whether price is selected instead of quantity (the default) as a conversion option for non-inventory line items on orders and invoices.

overrideDefaultTxnConversionType.description: For non-inventory items, this setting indicates whether the default conversion type on orders and invoices is changed to price.

enableMultipleDocumentConversion.description: Indicates whether multiple documents, including document lines, can be converted into a single Purchasing transaction so you can pay a vendor in one payment.

constructionPreferences.description: Preferences for companies that have Construction enabled.

prefillConversionZero.description: Indicates whether conversion price or quantity is prefilled with 0 (zero), depending on the conversion type.

includeFullyConvertedLines.description: Indicates whether fully converted lines are included during conversion.

enableReverseConversions.description: Indicates whether reverse conversions are enabled.

senderEmailProfile.description: Source for contact details (name, email address, and phone number) in emails with attached transactions.

contactsInTxn.description: Indicates whether transactions include all contacts or only contacts related to a specified vendor for pay-to, return-to, or deliver-to contacts.

enableAdvancedTax.description:
Indicates whether Advanced Tax is used as the tax calculation method. Create tax details, schedules, and tax schedule maps to define tax mapping for transaction calculations. When subscribed to the Taxes application, this setting defaults to `true` and cannot be modified.

Set this to `false` if you've enabled Avalara AvaTax or plan to use Simple Tax. Advanced Tax is not compatible with either of these tax calculation methods.

enableSubtotalTemplates.description: Indicates whether templates are used to populate subtotals in transaction definitions. You can configure transaction definitions to use different subtotals for different entities. Transactions created from an entity use the subtotals from the subtotal template associated with that entity.

overrideTaxScheduleOnLine.description: Indicates whether the tax entry level is overridden for purchase orders.

priceAndDiscountPreferences.description: Price and discount preferences for Purchasing transactions.

enablePriceSchedule.description: Indicates whether a price schedule associated with a vendor is applied to Purchasing transactions for that vendor.

enableVendorPriceLists.description: Indicates whether vendor price lists are enabled for Purchasing transactions. This lets you assign price lists to specific vendors. If you assign a price list to a vendor, that price list overrides the one associated with the Purchasing transaction definition.

enableFixedVendorDiscount.description: Indicates whether the fixed or blanket discount percentage for a vendor is applied to Purchasing transactions for that vendor.

itemPrecision.description: Default number of decimal places for unit price and cost is 2. Depending on your required precision, you can set up to 10 decimal places.

disableQuantityChange.description: Indicates whether certain changes are prevented during the workflow, such as increasing a line item's quantity or adding new line items. You can still decrease quantities and delete line items.

priceVarianceGLPostingPreferences.description: Price variance GL posting preferences for Purchasing transactions.

automatePriceVariancePosting.description: Indicates whether the variance between the standard cost and the actual purchase or invoice price is posted automatically.

purchasePriceVarianceGLAccount.description: Price variance GL account for Purchasing transactions.

key.description: System-assigned unique key for the price variance GL account.

id.description: ID for the price variance GL account.

href.description: URL endpoint for the price variance GL account.

key.description: System-assigned unique key for the invoice price variance GL account.

id.description: ID for the invoice price variance GL account.

href.description: URL endpoint for the invoice price variance GL account.

enablePurchasingApproval.description: Indicates whether the approval workflow is enabled for Purchasing transactions. Manage approval policies and rules through the `purchasing/approval-policy` object.

requireVendorForApproval.description: Indicates whether a vendor must be specified on a transaction before it is sent for approval. After a vendor is specified for the transaction, it cannot be changed.

requireReapproval.description:
Conditions under which a transaction requires reapproval:
- `noReapproval` - The transaction does not require reapproval.
- `lineAmountChange` - The transaction requires reapproval only if the line amount changes.
- `anyLineOrSubtotalAmountChange` - The transaction requires reapproval if any line or subtotal amount changes.

enableEmailNotifications.description: Indicates whether email notifications are enabled for Purchasing approval transactions.

enableDelegation.description: Indicates whether delegation is enabled for Purchasing approvals, allowing an admin user to delegate their approval tasks to another user.

adminApprover.description: Admin user who can terminate the rest of the approval cycle for a transaction by approving or declining it.

key.description: System-assigned unique key for the user.

href.description: URL endpoint for the user.

enableAdvanceWorkflow.description: Indicates whether advanced workflows are enabled for Purchasing transactions. Turning on advanced workflows cannot be reversed. If you enable advanced workflows in one application, they are automatically enabled for Order Entry, Purchasing, and Inventory Control.

automationPreferences.description:
With AP Automation with Purchasing, you define which Purchasing transactions to automate. You can automate transactions with document matching, without document matching, or both.
Instead of manually adding and converting Purchasing documents to vendor invoices, you can let Sage Intacct create incoming transactions using email or upload vendor invoice documents for automated processing.

enableAutomationWithDocumentMatching.description: Indicates whether transactions with document matching are automated. Manage transaction definition mapping through the `purchasing/txn-automation-preference` object.

enableLineLevelPOMatching.description: Indicates whether line-level matching is enabled for Purchasing automation. When enabled, automation matches document line items.

enableAutomationNoDocumentMatching.description: Indicates whether standalone purchase order matching is enabled for Purchasing automation. Manage transaction definition mapping through the `purchasing/txn-automation-without-match-preference` object.

enableForm1099.description: Indicates whether users can manage individual transaction line items for a 1099 vendor, excluding those items from a 1099 form. By default, transaction line items for a 1099 vendor are flagged for 1099 treatment.

enableOverrideForm1099.description: Indicates whether the default 1099 form and box associated with all transaction line items for a vendor can be overridden for an individual line item within a transaction. By default, all transaction line items for a vendor are associated with a specific 1099 form and box.

doNotValidateLinesBeforeDeleting.description: Set to `true` to validate whether a line reference exists between change order documents. A line reference between change orders determines the order in which you can delete change orders.

href.description: URL endpoint for the Purchasing preference.

txnAutomationWithoutMatchLines.description: Transaction automation preference details for transactions without matching.

exchangeRateType.description:
Specifies the exchange rate type used to determine current exchange rates. Exchange rate types are used only to customize your own exchange rates; the default is `intacctDailyRate`.

For more information, read [about the Intacct daily rate](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=About_daily_rate) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

translationMethod.description: Specifies the exchange rate translation method to be used for balance sheet accounts and income statement accounts.

balanceSheetTranslationMethod.description: Indicates the translation method for balance sheet accounts.

incomeTranslationMethod.description: Indicates the translation method for income statement accounts.

entity.description: Name for the entity used for elimination in the consolidation book.

enableInterEntityAutoElimination.description: Indicates whether to enable inter-entity auto-elimination.

adjustmentGLAccount.description: Specifies the General Ledger (GL) account for elimination adjustment.

href.description: URL endpoint for the GL account.

enableEliminationByAffiliateEntity.description: Indicates whether to enable elimination by affiliate entity.

consolidateDimensions.description: Standard Sage Intacct dimensions to include in the consolidated journal entries.

bookJournal.description: Provides details for the consolidation book journal.

* `false` - Run the consolidation online.

updateSubsequentPeriods.description:
Indicates whether to update all subsequent periods after the specified period when re-consolidating a past period:

* `true` - Update all subsequent periods after the specified period. Use when `runOffline` is `true` as offline consolidation is required to update subsequent periods.
* `false` - Do not update subsequent periods after the specified period. Deletes all subsequent periods after the specified period.

* `true` - Consolidate only the net changes since the last consolidation.
* `false` - Delete the existing consolidation and re-consolidate everything. Set to `false` when `updateSubsequentPeriods` is `true` as offline consolidation is required to update subsequent periods.

Specifies the method used to consolidate the data of both the parent and subsidiary entity.

* `consolidation` - Use when the parent entity has controlling interest of the subsidiary with ownership less than 100%.

For more information, read about [consolidation methods](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=About_Consolidation_methods) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

postingPeriodBasedOn.description:
Posting period to use when creating GL budget entries from the project contract. Must be a budgetable posting period. Defaults to projectContractDate.

* `projectBeginDate` - Post the amounts to the period in which the project contract begin date falls.
* `projectContractDate` - Post the amounts to the period that corresponds with the project contract `contractDate`. You can change this date, but you can't specify a date before the project contract begin date.
* `projectContractLineDate` - Post each project contract line to the `contractLineDate` for that line. Each line might post to different periods due to different effective dates. If you choose this option, specify a `contractLineDate` date for each line.
* `entryEffectiveDate` - Each project contract line entry and change request entry posts to the period containing the entry effective date.

objects.construction.project-estimate.description: A project estimate lets you compare estimated costs for a project against the actual amounts posted.

key.description: System-assigned unique key for the project estimate. Used to identify the estimate in URLs or JSON bodies for all operations.

id.description: Unique identifier of the project estimate.

href.description: URL endpoint URL for the project estimate.

description.description: Description of the project estimate.

postTo.description:
Posting period for the project estimate. 

* `firstPeriod` - Post the amounts to the period in which the project begin date falls. 
* `estimateDate` - Post estimate entries to the period that corresponds with the project `estimateDate`. You can change this date, but you can't enter a date before the project begin date.
* `effectiveDate` - Post each estimate line entry to the effective date for that line. Each line might post to different periods due to different effective dates. If you choose this option, enter an effective date for each line entry. Multiple estimate line entries for the same GL account, dimension, and budget period are summarized and posted as a single line to the same budget period.
* `allPeriods` - Spread the amounts equally across periods between the project begin and end date.

status.description:
The project estimate status.

* `active` - For current estimates.
* `inactive` - For historical estimates, such as an original customer bid.
* `finalized` - Lock the estimate from further changes. You can change a finalized estimate to active status at any time.

isPrimary.description: Specifies whether the estimate is primary for the project. During create, the first estimate for a project is set to primary. This value can be changed in an update.

isPrimaryForecast.description: Specifies whether the estimate is the primary forecast for the project. This value can be changed in an update. There can be at most one primary forecast for a project. When this value is set to true in a create or an update, then the 'isPrimaryForecast' value for all other estimates is set to false.

isPosted.description: Specifies whether the estimate is posted to GL budgets. In an update, if this is set to false, then any existing GL budgets for that project estimate will be deleted.

estimateDate.description: Date of the project estimate, which must be in a budgetable period.

currency.description: Currency derived from the Project.

budget.description: Reference to the budget that the estimate will be posted to. The budget must have `postProjectEstimates` set to `true`.

objects.construction.compliance-definiti.description: Compliance definitions provide validation rules and notification settings for tracking vendor compliance.

key.description: System-assigned unique key for the compliance definition.

id.description: Unique identifier for the compliance definition.

href.description: URL endpoint for the compliance definition.

description.description: Description for the compliance definition.
description.example: Compliance Definition used for Workers' Comp Insurance.

category.description: Determines the options that are available for `generateRule` and `validateRule` field settings. This value cannot be changed after a compliance definition is created.

trackBy.description:
Determines how to generate and track compliance records. If `category` is set to `insurance`, this field must be set to `vendor`.      

* `vendor` - The compliance definition is set up to track miscellaneous or insurance compliance records by vendor.
* `primaryDocument` - The compliance definition is set up to track miscellaneous, insurance, or lien waiver compliance records by primary document.

generateRule.description:
Determines if compliance records are automatically generated for this compliance definition.

* `doNotGenerate` - Specify this option if you do not want Sage Intacct to generate compliance records. You can create compliance records manually.
* `automaticByType` - Depending on the value of `trackBy`, you can specify vendors or transaction definitions. When this option is specified, Sage Intacct automatically generates a compliance record when creating a new vendor or primary document.

validationRule.description:
Specify validation rules only when `miscellaneous` is set as the compliance `category`. `documentReceived` is the default validation rule when `insurance` or `lienWaiver` is set as the compliance `category`.

* `expirationDate` - Sage Intacct compares the `expirationDate` field in the `construction.compliance-record` object to the `paymentDate` field in the `accounts-payable.payment` object. The vendor is non-compliant if the expiration date is before or on the payment date.
* `documentReceived` - The compliance definition is set up to validate a compliance record when the document is received.

paymentNotification.description:
Determines whether payment is allowed if a vendor is not in compliance.

* `error` - Does not allow making a payment to a vendor if their record is out of compliance.
* `warning` - Allows to pay AP bills and returns a warning if a vendor's record is out of compliance.
* `ignore` - Ignores whether a vendor's record is out of compliance.
