objects.order-entry.price-list-entry.description: Contains the pricing for a selected item within a selected price list. You can create price list entries for items whose prices are determined based on an amount, a discount or mark-up percentage, the quantity sold, and more.

key.description: System assigned unique key for the price list entry.

id.description: ID for the price list entry. This value is the same as the key for this object.

href.description: URL endpoint for the price list entry.

productLine.description: Specifies the product line to which the price list entry applies. If you specify a `productLine`, do not specify an `item` or `employee`.

key.description: Unique key for the product line.

id.description: Unique ID for the product line.

href.description: URL endpoint for the product line.

currency.description: Specifies the currency in which the price will be evaluated. This field is only applicable to multi-currency companies.

startDate.description:
Specifies the date on which the price becomes effective. Past or future dates are valid. Sage Intacct considers a price to be effective as of its start date. When suggesting a price for a selected item, Sage Intacct uses the price list entry that's effective as of the transaction date. 

The best practice is to ensure that each price list entry for an item or product line spans a unique start and end date range with no overlapping dates.

endDate.description:
Specifies the date on which the price ends. Past or future dates are valid. When suggesting a price for a selected item, Sage Intacct uses the price list entry that's effective as of the transaction date.

The best practice is to ensure that each price list entry for an item or product line spans a unique start and end date range with no overlapping dates.

minimumQuantity.description: Specify a `minimumQuantity` and `maximumQuantity` if you want to give or get price breaks according to the quantity ordered.  With this type of pricing, Sage Intacct  multiplies the transaction quantity by the rate mapped to the quantity range in which the transaction quantity falls.

maximumQuantity.description: Specify a `minimumQuantity` and `maximumQuantity` if you want to give or get price breaks according to the quantity ordered. With this type of pricing, Sage Intacct multiplies the transaction quantity by the rate mapped to the quantity range in which the transaction quantity falls.

value.description:
The value specified in this field depends on the type that you set in the `valueType` field. Not used when `enableTieredBilling` is `true`; pricing is determined by the `tiers` collection instead.
* `actual` - Specify the price of the item. For example, specify `500.00` if the item price is $500.00.
* `dollarMarkup` - Specify the amount to mark up the price. For example, specify `10.00` to mark up the price by $10.00.
* `dollarDiscount`- Specify the amount to subtract from the price. For example, specify `10.00` to discount the price by $10.00.
* `markupPercent` - Specify the percentage by which to mark up the price. For example, specify `20` to mark up the price by 20%.
* `discountPercent` - Specify the percentage that you want to subtract from the price. For example, specify `5` to discount the price by 5%.

valueType.description:
Value type for the price list entry.
* `actual` - The straight-forward price for the item, item and employee combination, or product line.
* `dollarMarkup` - Adds the amount provided in the `value` field to the last price list entry found for the same item.
* `dollarDiscount`- Subtracts the amount entered in the `value` field from the last price list entry found for the same item.
* `markupPercent` - Multiplies the amount of the last price list entry found by the percentage entered in the `value` field and then adds the result to the last price list entry found.
* `discountPercent` - Multiplies the amount of the last price list entry found by the percentage entered in the `value` field and then subtracts the result from the last price list entry found.

isFixedPrice.description: Indicates whether the price is the fixed or final price. In a cascading (or layered) price list structure, the first time Sage Intacct encounters `isFixedPrice` = `true` for an item, it presents that price as the suggested price on the transaction regardless of any other price defined for that item in other price lists.

employee.description:
This field is only applicable if a company is subscribed to Projects and Time and Expenses. Do not specify an `employee` if you are not defining a billing rate.

To define a project billing rate, use a combination of `employee` and `item`. Sage Intacct uses the price associated with the `item`/`employee` combination for applicable time sheets when generating invoices for time and materials projects.

key.description: Unique key for the employee.

href.description: URL endpoint for the employee.

item.description: Specifies the item to which the price list entry applies. If you specify an `item`, do not specify a `productLine`.

key.description: Unique key for the item.

href.description: URL endpoint for the item.

priceList.description: Price list associated with the price list entry.

key.description: Unique key for the price list.

id.description: Unique ID for the price list.

href.description: URL endpoint for the price list.

enableTieredBilling.description: Indicates whether tiered billing is enabled for this price list entry. When `true`, pricing is determined by evaluating the applicable quantity range across the `tiers` collection, and the `value` and `valueType` fields on the entry itself are ignored. Tiered billing is only available for items of type `Non-Inventory` or `Non-Inventory (Sales only)`.

tierCalculationType.description:
Specifies how the rate from the matching tier is applied to the transaction quantity when `enableTieredBilling` is `true`.
* `volume` - The rate for the tier that contains the total transaction quantity is applied to the **entire** quantity.
* `step` - Each unit of quantity is priced at the rate of the tier in which it falls, so different portions of the total quantity may be billed at different rates.
* `absolute` - The rate of the matching tier is applied as a flat fee regardless of the quantity.

tiers.description:
Ordered list of quantity tiers that define pricing breakpoints when `enableTieredBilling` is `true`. Each tier specifies a starting quantity and the rate applied from that quantity up to the next tier's starting quantity.

Rules:
* `beginQuantity` and `rate` are both required for every tier.
* `beginQuantity` must be 0 or greater.
* The tier with the lowest `beginQuantity` must have `beginQuantity` equal to `0`.

objects.order-entry.renewal-template.description: Order Entry renewal templates define the structure and rules for automating sales transaction renewals.

key.description: System-assigned key for the renewal template.

id.description: System-assigned ID for the renewal template. This value is the same as the `key` for this object.

href.description: URL endpoint for the renewal template.

description.description: Description of the renewal template.

enableTxnCreation.description: Indicates whether Sage Intacct should create a new sales transaction as part of the renewal.

transactionDefinition.description: Transaction definition associated with the renewal template.

key.description: Unique key for the transaction definition.

id.description: Unique ID for the transaction definition.

href.description: URL endpoint for the transaction definition.

daysBeforeAfter.description: The number of days before or after the source contract end date that Sage Intacct should create the sales transaction.

beforeOrAfterDateOfRenewal.description: Indicates whether Sage Intacct should create the transaction before or after the source renewal date.

txnDateOnRenewedDocument.description:
Establishes how the date on the sales transaction created by the renewal is determined.
* `calculatedDate` - Sage Intacct uses the transaction line item end date and adds or subtracts days based on the values of the `beforeOrAfterDateOfRenewal` and `daysBeforeAfter` fields.
* `contractEndDatePlusOneDay` - The system adds one day to the transaction line item end date.

txnLineItemStartDate.description:
Establishes how the line item start date on the sales transaction created by the renewal is determined.





 - `sameAsDocumentDate` - Sage Intacct uses the transaction date on the new sales transaction as the line item start date.
 - `inheritOffsetFromParent` - Sage Intacct keeps the number of days between the transaction date and the line item start date the same as exists in the source sales transaction.

contractPricing.description: Specifies the pricing option for contract renewal.

pricingType.description:
Contract pricing for the sales transaction type line item. 
 - `sameAsOriginal` - the renewed contract will use the same price for the line item as in the original sales transaction.
 - `defaultPricing` - Sage Intacct will use the suggested price for the renewed lines, if applicable. 
 - `custom` - (Contracts renewal template only) Requires the user to manually set a specific price on the contract line for the next renewal or series of renewals.
 - `markupOrMarkdown` - Sage Intacct will either discount or mark up the line item by the indicated percentage or actual amount.

markup.description: Pricing markup. Sage Intacct will either discount or mark up the line item by the indicated percentage or actual amount. Specify the percentage or actual amount in the `markupValue` field.

markupValue.description: Pricing markup value. For percentages, indicate the percentage as a whole number (for example, 5). For amounts, indicate the amount value (for example, 500.00).

renewalNotifications.description: Specifies details for customer and internal email notifications.

enableNotification.description: Indicates whether to send an email to the customer as part of the renewal process.

from.description: Specifies the email address you want the recipient to reply to.

to.description:
Specifies the customer contact email ID to use for notifications.  
- `customerContact` - The email ID from the customer contact.
- `customerBillToContact` - The bill-to contact for the customer. 
- `customerShipToContact` - The ship-to contact for the customer.

daysBeforeAfter.description: This field has been deprecated for order entry renewal templates and is no longer used.

Specifies the email template to use for the customer notification email. The email template can contain the appropriate From/To email address parameters and customized text.

Sage Intacct recommends that you use an email template for renewal templates. If a pertinent email address is updated in Sage Intacct, the email template can automatically pick up the new email address.

For example, enter 250. If `valueType` is `percent`, specify a percentage as a whole number. For example, 10 for 10%.
End users can override the default subtotal value in the transaction. It can have up to 10 decimals and should be a positive numeric field.

isApportioned.description: Indicates whether the discount subtotal will be apportioned across all line items in the transaction. Cannot be enabled if `isTax` is set to `true`.

isTax.description: Indicates whether the subtotal line is for tax. When the transaction posts, the tax posts separately based on the items in the transaction.

lastExecutionDate.description: Shows the final date for the scheduled execution of the recurring document.

frequency.description: This field has been deprecated. Use the `repeatBy` field instead.

executionCount.description: Shows the number of attempts to generate the recurring document. This value reflects the number of times the system has tried to create the document, which may differ from the number of successful transactions due to potential errors during execution.

For example, if you set `repeatBy` to `months` and set the `repeatInterval` to `3`, the schedule will run every 3 months.

objects.order-entry.recurring-schedule.description: Recurring schedules specify the frequency and duration of recurring Order Entry transactions. Recurring schedules are only used when a user converts an Order Entry transaction by line item.

key.description: System-assigned key for the recurring schedule.

id.description: Name or another unique ID for the recurring schedule.

description.description: Description of the recurring schedule to help users differentiate between similar schedules.

enableInstallmentPricing.description:
Specifies whether to divide the line item sales price by the number of times the transaction will repeat and create each transaction in the schedule with an installment price.

For example, if the line item price is $1,200 and the transaction will repeat 12 times, the system will create 12 transactions of $100 each.

endDate.description: Date on which the recurring schedule is to stop running.

repeatBy.description: Specifies the time period at which the transaction should recur. For example, to establish a weekly schedule, set `repeatBy` to `weekly` and the `repeatInterval` to `1`. Set `repeatBy` to `none` if the schedule should occur only once on a specific date.

repeatInterval.description: Specifies the number of intervals for the selected time period. For example, to have the schedule repeat every other week, set 'repeatBy' to `weeks` and specify `2` for this field.

repeatCount.description: The maximum number of times the scheduler should be executed.

startDateType.description:
Specifies how the date to start the recurring schedule is determined. The start date drives both the start of the recurring schedule and when the schedule is repeated, unless you set `repeatBy` to `endOfMonth`. 

For example, if the start date is on the 15th, the schedule repeats on the 15th day of the month if the recurring schedule is set to repeat every month. If the recurring schedule is set to repeat every week, the schedule repeats every 7 days, starting on the 15th day of the month.

 - `transactionDate` - The date in the Transaction date field on the transaction from which the line item is being converted is the start date.

 - `userSpecified` - The date the user enters in the Schedule Start Date field in the transaction's Line Item Entries Details section (in the Sage Intacct UI) is the start date.

createdByUser.description: The user who created the schedule.

key.description: System-assigned key for the userinfo.

id.description: Unique login ID for the user.

href.description: URL endpoint for the user.
URL endpoint for the recurring schedule.

objects.order-entry.txn-definition.description: An Order Entry transaction definition is the template for a sales transaction. It contains the accounting rules, workflow settings, and other configuration settings that determine a transaction's behavior.

key.description: System-assigned unique key for the transaction definition.

id.description: The name for the transaction definition.

href.description: URL endpoint for the transaction definition.

docClass.description: Order Entry transaction template type, which determines whether certain fields appear on a transaction.

workflowCategory.description: The workflow category associates the transaction with the applicable transaction menu grouping in the Order Entry menu.

description.description: A meaningful description of the transaction definition.

enableUserOrGroupPermission.description: By default, all users with the appropriate application permissions have access to transactions that use this transaction definition. To restrict access to certain users or groups, set this field to `true`.

enableUserOrGroupPermmission.description: This field has been deprecated. Use the `enableUserOrGroupPermission` field instead.

editPolicy.description:
Sets the edit permission for this transaction type.
* `noEdit` - The user cannot edit the transaction after it is created.
* `beforePrinting` - The user can edit the transaction until it has been printed to PDF. After it has been printed, the transaction cannot be edited.
* `editInDraftOnly`- The user can edit the transaction until it has been posted. After it has been posted, the transaction cannot be edited.
`all` - The user can edit the transaction as allowed by the transaction's condition. See [Edit a transaction](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Viewing_and_Managing_Order_Entry_Transaction_Lists) for editing restrictions.

deletePolicy.description:
Sets the delete permission for this transaction type. By default, a user cannot delete a transaction after it is created.
* `noDelete` - The user cannot delete the transaction after it is created.
* `beforePrinting` - The user can delete the transaction until it has been printed to PDF. After it has been printed, the transaction cannot be deleted.
* `all` - The user can delete the transaction as allowed by the transaction's condition. See [Edit a transaction](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Viewing_and_Managing_Order_Entry_Transaction_Lists) for editing restrictions.

enableNumberingSequence.description: Set to `true` to enable numbering sequences to be set for transactions.

preserveNumberingSequence.description: Set to `true` to ensure that numbers in a sequence are never skipped. Enabling this option can affect performance when a large volume of transactions is entered at the same time.

inheritDocumentNumber.description: Set to `true` if transactions should inherit source document numbers. For example, a transaction could inherit a sales invoice number.

inventoryUpdateType.description: Specify if inventory will be affected by the transaction and, if so, whether to track the quantity, value, or both.

increaseOrDecreaseInventory.description: Specify whether the inventory running total is increased or decreased by the transaction.

txnPostingMethod.description: Specify whether the transaction post process creates a GL entry and, if so, whether it will post directly to the GL or to the AR subledger.

disableTax.description: Set to `true` to disable tax capture for the transaction.

enableFulfillment.description: Set to `true` to enable the transaction definition for fulfillment.

enableReservingAndPicking.description: Set to `true` to enable inventory items for reserving and picking.

partialConvertMethod.description:
Specify how the system processes transactions that are partially complete.
* `leaveTransactionOpen` - When the user converts the transaction to another transaction type, the system leaves the original transaction open until all items are completed.
* `closeOriginalAndCreateBackOrder` - When the user converts the transaction to another transaction type and enters an item quantity that's less than the original transaction quantity, the system closes the original transaction and creates a new transaction for the remaining item quantity.
* `closeTransaction` - When the user converts the transaction to another transaction type, the system closes the original transaction regardless of whether the transaction is complete.
See [Convert part of a transaction](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Partially_converted_transactions) in the Sage Intacct Help Center for more information.

affectsCost.description: If true the transaction will affect the costing of order entry.

overrideExchangeRateType.description: Indicates whether users can edit the Exchange rate and/or Exchange rate type fields of the transaction.

showBaseCurrency.description:
Specifies whether the transaction amounts are displayed in both base currency and transaction currency. The following fields display amounts in the currency selected as the transaction currency on a transaction: Price, Extended price, Transaction value, and Transaction total.
If `showBaseCurrency` is set to `true`, the transaction currency amount fields appear and the following fields also appear: Base price, Extended base price, Base value, and Base total. These additional fields display the amounts in the company's base currency.

overridePrice.description: Set to `true` to allow users to override line item prices on the transaction.

trackDiscountAndSurcharge.description: Indicates whether users can discount transaction line items.

allowDiscountOnExtendedPrice.description: Indicates whether the transaction definition can be used for contract invoices. This field is only applicable if the company is subscribed to Contracts.

requireMemoForDiscount.description: Indicates whether users must provide notes for line items being discounted before saving a transaction.

displayDraftsOnRevenueTxnEntriesPage.description: Indicates whether the transaction can be displayed on the Revenue transaction entries page when in a draft state.

freezeRecallValue.description: Set to `true` to freeze recalled values.

enableSubtotals.description: Set to `true` to specify standard subtotals, such as tax or a discount, for the transaction.

showExpandedTaxDetails.description: Set to `true` to show expanded tax details in the transaction user interface and in printed output. This field applies only to companies that use Avalara AvaTax or Sage Intacct Advanced Tax.

enableOverrideTax.description: Indicates whether users can override whether a line item is taxable.

revenueRecognitionType.description: Specifies whether revenue recognition applies to transactions created from this definition and, if so, whether to post the revenue recognition or only display it. This field applies only to companies subscribed to Revenue Management and is applicable only to Order Entry revenue recognition.

revrecEnablementType.description: This field has been deprecated. Use the `revenueRecognitionType` field instead.

renewalEnablementType.description: Specifies whether contract renewals apply to the transaction type and, if so, whether the renewal is set up to generate when the transaction posts or the renewal fields are displayed in the transaction so users can select a renewal transaction set.

enableLineItemConversion.description: Set to `true` to allow users to convert a sales transaction by line item into a scheduled recurring transaction.

allowRenewConvertedLineOnly.description: This field is only applicable if `renewalEnablementType` is set to `generate`. Set this field to `true` if the system should only renew line items that were converted in the original sales transaction. Set to `false` if all indicated line items should be renewed, regardless of conversion status.

allowLocationOverride.description: Set to 'true' to allow users to override the location set for the transaction.

allowDepartmentOverride.description: Set to `true` to allow users to override the department set for the transaction.

xslTemplate.description: Document template to use for printed output (PDFs).

fixedMessage.description: This message is displayed in the Print/Email document.
fixedMessage.example: For any inquiries or assistance, please contact our customer service.

contactOneTitle.description: Use this field to change the Bill-to labels on the transaction and on the printed document.

contactTwoTitle.description: Use this field to change the Ship-to labels on the transaction and on the printed document.

printBillToContact.description: Set to `true` to show the Bill-to contact in the printed document.

printShipToContact.description: Set to `true` to show the Ship-to contact in the printed document.

allowEditingBillToContact.description: Set to `true` to allow users to change the Bill-to contact during transaction entry.

allowEditingShipToContact.description: Set to `true` to allow users to change the Ship-to contact during transaction entry.

enableWarnOnLowQuantity.description: Set to `true` to alert the user when the quantity needed is greater than the `ONHAND` total in the selected warehouse. The warning also shows the `ONORDER` and `ONHOLD` totals.

enableCreditLimitCheck.description: Specifies whether to enforce customer credit limit restrictions in transactions created from this definition.

warehouseSelectionMethod.description: Specifies how warehouses are presented to the user in the warehouse list in the transaction.

enablePayments.description: Set to `true` to enable users to apply payments to an invoice in Order Entry and to set a recurring template to automatically charge a credit card when an invoice is generated (if the company is subscribed to Payment Services).

latestVersionKey.description: System-assigned version key for the order entry transaction definition.

postToGL.description: Set to `true` to enable additional posting to the General Ledger.

requireSupplyOfPrices.description: Set to `true` if a price must be supplied.

enableCosting.description: Set to `true` to enable costing for non-inventoried items.

documentConversionPolicy.description:
Document conversion policy.
* `newDocumentOnly` - The user can create the transaction as a standalone transaction (by selecting Add from a transaction list, or the plus icon next to the transaction definition in the Sage Intacct menu, or by copying an existing transaction, and so on).
* `newDocumentOrConvert` - The user can create the transaction as a standalone transaction or the user can create the transaction by converting the previous transaction in the workflow.
* `convertOnly` - The user can only create the transaction by converting the previous transaction in the workflow. For example, the user can only create a sales invoice by converting an existing sales order.

multiEntityRuleForTransaction.description: Sets the context for where users can create transactions from this transaction definition within a multi-entity, shared environment.

enableProjectActualBillings.description: Set to `true` to enable display of actual billings on printed or emailed invoices.

lineLevelSimpleTax.description: Set to `true` to allow the tax rate to be overridden at the line level when using Simple Tax. This option appears only if `enableSubtotals` is set to `true`.

customerVendorEditRule.description:
Allow users to change the customer in Draft or Pending transactions if the transaction has not been converted to another transaction, the transaction date is in an open period, and the transaction's payment status is not `Paid` or `Partially paid`.
This field follows any editing restrictions imposed by the `editPolicy` field and is only applicable if the edit policy is set to `all` or `beforePrinting`. 
* `always` - The user can edit the customer in all applicable scenarios.
* `exceptConvertedDocuments` - The user can edit the customer in the first transaction in a workflow but not in transactions created by conversion.
* `never` - The user cannot edit the customer.

enableRetainage.description: For companies subscribed to Construction, set to 'true' to enable retainage.

enableAdditionalInformationScope.description: For companies subscribed to Construction, set to 'true' to enable identification of work that is included and excluded, the reason why, and the terms.

enableAdditionalInformationSchedule.description: For companies subscribed to Construction, set to 'true' to enable identification of dates for work milestones.

enableInternalReference.description: For companies subscribed to Construction, set to 'true' to enable identification of who authorized work internally and when they authorized the work.

enableExternalReference.description: For companies subscribed to Construction, set to 'true' to enable identification of who authorized work externally and when they authorized the work.

enableBond.description: For companies subscribed to Construction, set to 'true' to identify information about performance and payment bonds.

documentChangeType.description: Indicates whether to enable changes to the transaction definition and, if so, how to handle changes.

reportingCategory.description: Establishes a reporting category that best reflects the purpose of the transaction definition so that similar documents can be grouped when building reports. This field is applicable for use with Interactive Custom Report Writer or Interactive Visual Explorer subscriptions only.

enableContractBilling.description: Set to `true` to display the project contract billing for transactions. This option also displays project contract billing details on Order Entry Contract invoices.

arPostingMethod.description: Update method for project contract totals.

documentSequence.description: Specify the document numbering sequence to use to automatically number transactions. Omit a numbering sequence if transactions are to be numbered manually or if they will inherit the source document number (`inheritDocumentNumber` is set to `true`).

key.description: Unique key for the document numbering sequence.

href.description: URL endpoint for the document numbering sequence.

id.description: ID of the document numbering sequence.

initialPriceList.description: The first price list the system will evaluate when determining a suggested transaction price.

href.description: URL endpoint for the price list.

key.description: Unique key for the price list.

updatePriceList.description: The price list that will be updated when a user saves a transaction.

href.description: URL endpoint for the price list.

key.description: Unique key for the price list.

id.description: The name of the price list.

specialPriceList.description: If using layered price lists, this indicates a special price list (for example, a discounted price list or seasonal price list). The special price list takes precedence over the initial price list.

href.description: URL endpoint for the price list.

key.description: Unique key for the price list.

warehouse.description: Specify the default warehouse. Applies only if the `warehouseSelectionMethod` is set to `useTheDefaultWarehouse`.

key.description: Unique key for the warehouse.

href.description: URL endpoint for the warehouse.

id.description: Unique name or other ID for the warehouse.

shippingMethod.description: The default for how goods in the transaction are shipped to the customer. If a shipping method is specified for a customer, the customer shipping method takes precedence as the default in the transaction.

href.description: URL endpoint for the shipping method.

key.description: Unique key for the shipping method.

subtotalTemplate.description: Specifies the template for populating the transaction subtotals table.

href.description: URL endpoint for subtotal template.

key.description: Unique key for the subtotal template.

arTerm.description: Accounts Receivable (AR) term, which determines the expiration date for quotes and the due date for invoices.

href.description: URL endpoint for the AR term.

key.description: Unique key for the AR term.

exchangeRateType.description: Specify a custom exchange rate type if transactions should not default to the Sage Intacct Daily Rate.

key.description: Unique key for the exchange rate type.

id.description: The name of exchange rate type.

href.description: URL endpoint for the exchange rate type.

cogsGLDetail.description: Specify the COGS GL accounts to debit and credit. For companies that do not use Inventory Control, these accounts are required when the `enableCosting` field is set to `true`.

COGSGLDetail.description: This field has been deprecated. Use the `cogsGLDetail` field instead.

accountReceivableOrDirectGLDetail.description: When the `txnPostingMethod` field is set to `toAR` or `toGL`, specify the AR or GL accounts to debit and credit.

additionalGLDetail.description: When the `txnPostingMethod` field is set to `toAR` and the `postToGL` field is set to `true`, specify the GL account details for additional GL account posting. These accounts are used to reverse the previous transaction in the workflow.

inventoryTotalDetail.description: Specifies the inventory running total that will be affected by the transaction and how the total will be affected.

subtotalDetail.description: Provides details about the type of subtotals that are supported for the transaction.

sourceDocumentDetail.description: Provides document conversion details for the transaction.

entitySettingDetail.description: Provides details about the entities that can create transactions, and also includes settings for each entity, such as numbering sequences and document templates.

key.description: System-assigned key for the location.

href.description: URL endpoint for the location.

objects.projects.project.description: Use projects in Sage Intacct to plan, manage, track, and report on work across your organization.

key.description: System-assigned unique key for the project.

description.description: Provides a brief description for the project.

projectCurrency.description: Specifies the currency used for the project.

category.description: Specifies the project category, used mainly for reporting and filtering purposes. You can use project categories to group and categorize projects.

projectStatus.description: References the current project status, used to track the progress of projects through different states. You can also use the project status to restrict transactions in the project.

key.description: Unique key for the project status.

disableGenerateInvoice.description: Indicates whether to generate project invoices for the project in the specified status. Set to `true` to prevent invoice generation.

disablePurchasingAPEntry.description: Indicates whether to create Accounts Payable (AP) or Purchase Order (PO) entries for the project in the specified status. Set to `true` to prevent AP/PO entries.

disableExpenseEntry.description: Indicates whether to create expense entries for the project in the specified status. Set to `true` to prevent expense entries.

disableTimesheetEntry.description: Indicates whether to create timesheet entries for the project in the specified status. Set to `true` to prevent timesheet entries.

href.description: URL endpoint for the project status.

startDate.description: Specifies the scheduled start date for the project.

endDate.description: Specifies the scheduled end date for the project.

budget.description: Indicates the budget projections for the project.

billingAmount.description: Budgeted billing amount for the project.

budgetedDuration.description: Budgeted duration (in hours) for the project.

glBudget.description: References the General Ledger (GL) budget used by revenue recognition to calculate the projected cost amount for the project.

key.description: Unique key for the budget.

href.description: URL endpoint for the budget.

contractAmount.description: Specifies the contracted amount for the project for reporting purposes.

actualAmount.description: Specifies the actual amount for the project for reporting purposes.

progress.description: Indicates the calculated progress for the project.

estimatedDuration.description: Estimated duration for the project in hours.

actualDuration.description: Actual duration for the project in hours.

approvedDuration.description: Approved duration for the project in hours.

remainingDuration.description: Remaining duration for the project in hours, calculated as the difference between estimated and actual duration.

percentComplete.description: Calculated percentage of project completion, based on the ratio of actual duration to estimated duration for project tasks.

observedPercentComplete.description: Observed percentage of project completion, indicating how complete the project is as of a specific date.

billingType.description:
Specifies how the project will be invoiced:

- `timeAndMaterial` - Invoices the customer for any time entry, expense, or AP/PO purchase that's marked as billable and assigned to this project.
- `fixedFee` - Invoices the customer for fixed fees, based on line items in an Order Entry transaction definition.
- `fixedFeeAndExpenses` - Invoices the customer for fixed fees, based on line items in an Order Entry transaction definition, plus any billable expenses.

salesOrderNumber.description: Specifies the sales order number for the project.

purchaseOrderNumber.description: Indicates the purchase order number for the project.

purchaseOrderAmount.description: Specifies the project purchase order amount.

purchaseQuoteNumber.description: Indicates the project purchase quote number.

documentNumber.description: Specifies a document number that can be used for custom project reporting.

parent.description: References the immediate parent project in the project hierarchy when the current project is a child project.

key.description: Unique key for the parent project.

href.description: URL endpoint for the parent project.

invoiceWithParent.description: Indicates whether to include project transactions in invoices for the parent project.

rootProject.description: References the root project at the highest level in the project hierarchy.

key.description: Unique key for the root project.

href.description: URL endpoint for the root project.

wipScheduleProject.description:
References the project included in the work-in-progress (WIP) schedule. This project consolidates values from multiple projects into a single WIP reporting project.

For more information, read [include projects in work in progress (WIP) schedules](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=include_projects_in_wip) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

key.description: Unique key for the WIP reporting project.

id.description: Identifier for the WIP reporting project.

name.description: Name for the WIP reporting project.

href.description: URL endpoint for the WIP reporting project.

excludeFromWIPSchedule.description: Indicates whether to exclude the project from work in progress schedules.

customer.description: References the customer associated with the project.

key.description: Unique key for the customer.

href.description: URL endpoint for the customer.

salesContact.description: References the sales contact for the project.

key.description: Unique key for the sales contact.

href.description: URL endpoint for the sales contact.

projectType.description: References the project type, used to categorize and report on projects. Project types let you group projects into categories for reporting.

key.description: Unique key for the project type.

href.description: URL endpoint for the project type.

manager.description: References the project manager for the project. Project managers usually approve timesheets and expense reports, they can also run and view project reports.

key.description: Unique key for the project manager.

href.description: URL endpoint for the project manager.

quantitySurveyor.description: References the quantity surveyor for the project. Quantity surveyor is responsible for the commercial and financial management of the project.

key.description: Unique key for the quantity surveyor.

href.description: URL endpoint for the quantity surveyor.

department.description: References the department associated with this project. The project department overrides any department associated with an employee on a timesheet. If a project department is not set, the employee department is used.

key.description: Unique key for the department.

href.description: URL endpoint for the department.

location.description:
References the location associated with this project. The project location overrides any location associated with an employee on a timesheet. If a project location is not set, the employee location is used.

If you subscribe to Construction and you use WIP management, changing a project's location can cause the project to be handled incorrectly in WIP schedules. After changing a project's location, [check WIP project settings to ensure that the project is handled correctly in WIP schedules](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=include_projects_in_wip).

key.description: Unique key for the project location.

href.description: URL endpoint for the project location.

cipAsset.description: References the asset in construction in progress (CIP) associated with the project.

key.description: Unique key for the CIP asset.

name.example: Course Delivery Laptop - CIP Capital Equipment

href.description: URL endpoint for the CIP asset.

paymentTerm.description: References the Accounts Receivable (AR) payment term for the project, included on the invoice header. If `paymentTerm` is not set, the customer's terms are used.

key.description: Unique key for the AR payment term.

id.description: Identifier for the AR payment term.

href.description: URL endpoint for the AR payment term.

customerUser.description: References the Sage Intacct user assigned as a customer representative with the ability to approve timesheets for the project.

key.description: Unique key for the customer user.

href.description: URL endpoint for the customer user.

class.description: References the class associated with this project. A class adds a value to the dimension that you can use to tag transactions for reporting.

key.description: Unique key for the class.

href.description: URL endpoint for the class.

userRestrictions.description:
Indicates the user restrictions for entering project time and expenses, overriding default user restrictions for the Projects application:





  - `systemDefault` - Use the restrictions set for the Projects application.
  - `anyUser` - Allow any user to enter time and expenses for the project.
  - `projectUsers` - Allow only users assigned to the project to enter time and expenses.
  - `projectTaskUsers` - Allow only users assigned to the project and task to enter time and expenses.

isBillableEmployeeExpense.description: Indicates whether to bill employee expenses for the project.

isBillablePurchasingAPExpense.description: Indicates whether to bill Accounts Payable (AP) and Purchase Order (PO) expenses for the project. Set to `true` to bill AP/PO expenses.

ratesAndPricing.description: Specifies the methods used to determine project billing rates and pricing, either `laborPricing` or `expensePricing`.

laborPricing.description:
Specifies the method used to determine labor pricing:

- `billingRate` - Pricing is based on a predefined billing rate. 
- `costPlusFee` - Pricing is based on actual costs plus a markup percentage.

laborMarkup.description: Indicates the percentage to add to labor costs when `laborPricing` is set to `costPlusFee`.

expensePricing.description:
Specifies the method used to determine expense pricing.

- `billingRate` - Charges are based on the vendor's billing rate.
- `costPlusFee` - Charges are based on the vendor's standard rate plus a markup percentage, specified in `expenseMarkup`.

expenseMarkup.description: Indicates the percentage to add to expense costs when `expensePricing` is set to `costPlusFee`.

defaultRate.description: Indicates the default percentage used to calculate pricing for Accounts Payable (AP), and Purchase Order (PO) transactions when generating project invoices.

purchasingAPPricing.description: Specifies the pricing method to be used for Accounts Payable (AP), and Purchase Order (PO) transactions.

contacts.description: References contact information for the project.

site.description: References the site contact for the project, the person or organization responsible for the project.

key.description: Unique key for the site contact.

href.description: URL endpoint for the site contact.

primary.description: References the primary contact for the project, the person or organization responsible for the project.

key.description: Unique key for the primary contact.

href.description: URL endpoint for the primary contact.

billTo.description: References the bill-to contact associated with the project, the person or organization responsible for paying project invoices. If not set, the customer contact will be used.

key.description: Unique key for the bill-to contact.

href.description: URL endpoint for the bill-to contact.

shipTo.description: References the ship-to contact for the project, the person or organization to whom project invoices are sent. If not set, the customer contact is used for shipping.

key.description: Unique key for the ship-to contact.

href.description: URL endpoint for the ship-to contact.

invoiceMessage.description: Specifies a custom invoice message that appears on the invoice header when you generate invoices for the project.

invoiceCurrency.description: Specifies the currency to use when generating invoices for the project.

billingOverMax.description:
Indicates the billing control to prevent or warn of billings that exceed the budgeted billing amount:





  - `doNothing` - Take no action if billings exceed the projected billing amount.
  - `issueAWarningMessage` - Issue a warning message when billings exceed the budgeted billing amount, but allow the billing to proceed.
  - `preventBilling` - If the invoice amount exceeds your projected billing amount, you cannot generate an invoice.

excludeExpenses.description: Indicates whether to exclude employee, Accounts Payable (AP), and Purchase Order (PO) expenses from the over-budget calculation. Set to `true` to exclude these expenses.

contract.description: References the contract associated with the project.

key.description: Unique key for the contract.

href.description: URL endpoint for the contract.

attachment.description: References documents associated with the project, such as statements of work, specifications, or agreements.

key.description: Unique key for the attachment.

href.description: URL endpoint for the attachment.

grant.description: References grant funding information for the project.

aln.description: Specifies the ALN (Assistance Listing Number) found on the Federal award letter was formerly known as CFDA (Catalog of Federal Domestic Assistance). The ALN tracks federal awards and cooperative agreements. Reporting and auditing use the ALN.

fundedProjectName.description: Name for the project receiving the grant funding.

agency.description: Agency responsible for the grant funding, for example, `World Bank`.

payer.description: Source of the grant funding (`federal` or `third party`).

otherId.description: Provides an additional identifier for the grant funding.

assistanceType.description: Indicates the type of grant funding (`cash` or `nonCash`).

revenueRestriction.description:
Indicates the type of restriction on the received grant funding:

  - `purpose` - Funds are restricted by purpose, for example, to be used for a specific program or project, for example on education initiatives.
  - `time` - Funds are restricted by time, for example, to be used in a specific time period, for example within the current fiscal year.
  - `NA` - There are no restrictions on the use of the funds, there are no purpose or time restrictions.
  - `null` - If 'null', revenue restriction is not specified.

restrictionExpirationDate.description: Date when first restriction expires on time-based restricted funding.

isTimeSatisfactionScheduled.description: Indicates whether the release of restriction has been scheduled for time-based restrictions. Set to `true` if scheduled.

scopeDetails.description:
References information about the scope and schedule for the project, including scope of work, inclusions, exclusions, and terms. (Construction subscription)

For more information, read [add the scope and schedule to a project](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Add_scope_and_schedule_to_project) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

scope.description: Scope of the project, for example, the expected scope of work or materials to be delivered. Use 4000 or fewer characters.
scope.example: Subcontractor agrees to provide labor and materials for utility trenching for Five Oaks Storage facilities according to contract.

inclusions.description: Inclusions for the project, for example, items that are explicitly included in the terms of this project. Use 4000 or fewer characters.
inclusions.example: Includes drive through building and landscaping materials.

exclusions.description: Exclusions for the project, for example, items that are explicitly excluded in the terms of this project. Use 4000 or fewer characters.
exclusions.example: Excludes additional purchases of landscaping materials.

terms.description: Terms of the project, these may include additional terms or performance obligations. Use 4000 or fewer characters.
terms.example: Follow all safety rules and security procedure that are in force and applicable during execution of work.

scheduleDetails.description: References the schedule information for the project.

scheduledStartDate.description: Scheduled start date, the date the project is scheduled to start.

scheduledCompletionDate.description: Original scheduled completion date, the date the project is scheduled to be completed.

actualStartDate.description: Actual start date, the date the project actually started.

actualCompletionDate.description: Actual completion date, the date the project was actually completed.

revisedCompletionDate.description: Revised completion date, the revised date the project is scheduled to be completed.

substantialCompletionDate.description: Substantial completion date, the date the work for the project is considered substantially complete.

noticeToProceedDate.description: Notice to proceed date, the date when the project received formal notice to proceed.

responseDueDate.description: Response due date, the date when a response is expected from an external party for the project.

executedOnDate.description: Executed on date, the date the project was formally executed.

scheduleImpactNotes.description: Provide additional context about any impacts on the current schedule for the project. Use 100 or fewer characters.
scheduleImpactNotes.example: There are currently no schedule impacts.

taxSchedule.description: If Advanced Tax or VAT is enabled, the tax schedule used to capture tax details for the project.

key.description: Unique key for the tax schedule.

id.description: Unique ID of the tax schedule.

href.description: URL endpoint for the tax schedule.

taxSolution.description: Tax solution used to calculate and capture taxes on the project.

key.description: Unique key for the tax solution.

href.description: URL endpoint for the tax solution.

objects.projects.project-resource.description: Project resources represent people or employees assigned to a project. You can assign a resource, typically an employee, to a project, including details such as billing rates, roles and assignment dates.

key.description: System-assigned unique key for the project resource.

id.description: Unique identifier for the project resource. This is the same as `key` for this object.

href.description: URL endpoint for the project resource.

description.description: Description of the project resource.

startDate.description: Start date for the project resource, the date on which the project resource is scheduled to begin work.

employee.description: References the employee identified as the project resource.

key.description: Unique key for the employee.

startDate.description: Start date for the employee, the date on which the employee is scheduled to begin work.

endDate.description: End date for the employee, the date on which the employee is scheduled to end work.

href.description: URL endpoint for the employee.

employeeContact.description: References the contact information for the employee identified as the project resource.

key.description: Unique key for the employee contact.

href.description: URL endpoint for the employee contact.

item.description:
References an item for setting project-specific pricing for the project resource. You can assign an item to a project resource to set project-specific pricing for the resource.  The following rules apply when assigning an item to a project resource: 

- If pricing is set for an item without specifying an employee, the pricing applies to the item regardless of the employee.
- If an employee and item are specified together with a `laborRate` or `expenseRate`, the pricing applies to timesheet entries or expenses entered by the employee.

  For more information, watch the video [assign project resources and pricing](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Video_assign_project_resources_pricing) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

key.description: Unique key for the item.

href.description: URL endpoint for the item.

pricing.description:
Specifies the method used to determine pricing for the project resource, either `laborPricingMethod` or `expensePricingMethod`.

For more information, watch the video [assign project resources and pricing](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Video_assign_project_resources_pricing) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

laborPricingMethod.description:
Specifies the method used to determine labor pricing for the project resource. Labor pricing is based on a predefined billing rate or cost plus a markup percentage.

- `billingRate` - Pricing is based on a predefined billing rate. 
- `costPlusFee` - Pricing is based on actual costs plus a markup percentage.

laborRate.description: Specifies the default labor rate for the project resource, applied when the resource logs time to the project. If a project resource has a specified `item` and the `laborRate` differs from the item's rate, the `laborRate` takes precedence. If they have multiple labor rates for the same scheduled time, only the first rate is applied.

expensePricingMethod.description:
Specifies the method used to determine expense pricing for the project resource.

- `billingRate` - Pricing is based on a predefined billing rate. 
- `costPlusFee` - Pricing is based on actual costs plus a markup percentage.

expenseRate.description: Specifies the default expense rate for the project resource, applied when the resource logs expenses to the project.

apPurchasingPricingMethod.description: Specifies the pricing method to be used for Accounts Payable (AP), and Purchase Order (PO) transactions, `costPlusFee` indicates that pricing is based on actual costs plus a markup percentage.

apPurchasingRate.description: Specifies the default percentage used to calculate pricing for the project resource, applied when generating invoices for Accounts Payable (AP) and Purchase Order (PO).

project.description: References the project associated with this project resource.

key.description: Unique key for the project.

href.description: URL endpoint for the project.

objects.projects.project-status.description: Project statuses let you track the progress of projects through different states, used to categorize and report on projects.

key.description: System-assigned unique key for project status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the project status.

description.description: Provides a brief description of the purpose of the project status.
description.example: Project is in the planning phase and not yet open for time or expense entry.

disableTimesheetEntry.description: Indicates whether to create timesheet entries for the project in the specified status. Set to `true` to prevent timesheet entries.

disableExpenseEntry.description: Indicates whether to create expense entries for the project in the specified status. Set to `true` to prevent expense entries.

disablePurchasingAPEntry.description: Indicates whether to create Accounts Payable (AP) or Purchase Order (PO) entries for the project in the specified status. Set to `true` to prevent AP/PO entries.

disableGenerateInvoice.description: Indicates whether to generate project invoices for the project in the specified status. Set to `true` to prevent invoice generation.

href.description: Endpoint for this project status.

objects.projects.project-type.description: Project types let you group projects into categories for reporting.

key.description: System-assigned unique key for the project type.

id.description: Unique identifier for the project type.

groupType.description:
Specifies the group membership type for the project. The group type and related fields determine how projects will be organized hierarchically and how related projects will be managed in the Projects list. There are two types of project groups:





  - `specific` - Specify the projects to include and their hierarchical relationships in the `groupMembers` array.
  - `all` - Include all projects that match the `memberFilter` criteria.

Depending on the group type, you can either specify individual projects to include and their order, or include all projects that match certain criteria. This will impact how parent and child projects are displayed and managed, providing up to 5 levels of hierarchical organization for enhanced billing flexibility and organizational clarity.

memberFilter.description:
One or more filters to select the projects to include in the project group, can be used with both `all` and `specific` group types. 

You can use this filter to show only projects managed by the current user: `{"$eq":{"manager.id":"current(user)"}}`

objects.projects.task.description:
Tasks simplify the process of capturing task data for projects as you enter transactions. The uniqueness of a task is bound to a specific project, meaning you cannot select a task without first identifying the project. 

For more information, read more about [task dimensions](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Task_dimension_overview) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

planned.description: Defines the scheduled start and end dates for the task.

startDate.description: Specifies the date on which the project is scheduled to begin.

endDate.description: Specifies the date on which the project is scheduled to end.

actual.description: Defines the actual start and end dates for the task.

endDate.description: Specifies the date on which the project actually ended.

duration.description: Indicates planned, estimated, actual, approved and remaining time values, including both total and billable durations.

planned.description: The initial scheduled duration of the task, measured in hours.

plannedBillable.description: The portion of the planned duration expected to be billable to the customer, measured in hours.

estimated.description: Represents the current estimated total duration of the task, measured in hours.

estimatedBillable.description: The current estimated total duration of the task, in hours, based on updated information or progress.

actual.description: The total number of hours recorded against the task. Reflects the actual effort spent to date, regardless of billable status.

actualBillable.description: The total number of billable hours recorded against the task. Represents the portion of actual work eligible for invoicing.

approved.description: The total number of hours recorded against the task that have been reviewed and approved, regardless of billable status.

approvedBillable.description: The total number of billable hours recorded against the task that have been reviewed and approved for invoicing.

remaining.description: The estimated number of hours required to completed the task, this is automatically calculated.

percentComplete.description: Indicates the calculated percentage of task completion, recorded as a decimal. For example, a value of `0.25` represents 25% completion. This value is automatically calculated by dividing the actual hours worked on the task by the estimated duration.

observedPercentComplete.description: Represents the manually entered percentage of task completion, recorded as a decimal. For example, a value of `0.75` represents 75% completion.

isMilestone.description: Indicates whether the task is a milestone. Set to `true` to designate the task as a key project checkpoint or deliverable.

isUtilized.description: Indicates whether the task contributes to project utilization. Set to `true` to mark the task as utilized, meaning the time spent is considered productive work on a customer or internal project. When set to `false`, represents a non-productive task, such as administration.

isBillable.description: Indicates whether the time recorded against the task is billable to a customer. Set to `true` to include the task in invoicing.

wbsCode.description: Specifies the work breakdown structure (WBS) code for the task. This code can contain up to 8 characters and is used to categorize and organize tasks within the project.

priority.description: Specifies the task's priority using a numeric value, A numeric value indicating the task priority.

taskStatus.description: Indicates the current status of the task. Once a task is marked as `completed`, no additional time entries can be recorded against it.

timeType.description:
Specifies the time type to be associated with this task, such as salary or overtime. Used for posting labor costs to the general ledger and for tracking how working time is categorized. 

This field is required if labor cost posting is enabled. For more information, read about how to [setup labor cost posting](https://www.intacct.com/ia/docs/en_US/help_action/Default.htm#cshid=Set_up_labor_cost_posting) in the Sage Intacct Help Center.

invoiceType.description:
Specifies whether the transaction is a regular invoice (invoice), an electronic invoice (eInvoice), or an invoice reported to the tax agency because it is not eligible for e-invoicing (eReporting).

The eInvoice value is retained for backward compatibility. PO E-Invoices cannot be created directly.

invoiceMode.description:
Invoice mode for France e-invoicing workflows; applicable only for France e-invoice enabled entities.
Supported values:





  - `b1` - Submission of an e-invoice for goods. Retained for backward compatibility.
  - `s1` - Submission of an e-invoice for services. Retained for backward compatibility.
  - `tlb1` - E-Reporting mode for goods.
  - `tps1` - E-Reporting mode for services.

Leave this field blank when `invoiceType` is `invoice`.

eInvoiceStatus.description:
Current status of an e-invoice; applicable only when selected invoice type is eInvoice.

Supported statuses:
- `submitted` - The supplier submits its invoice or credit note to the public invoicing portal or its registered private platform.
- `issuedByPlatform` - The invoice has been processed on the supplier’s platform and issued to the buyer.
- `fileUploaded` - The invoice file has been uploaded to the platform.
- `madeAvailable` - The invoice has been made available to the buyer on the public invoicing portal or its registered private platform.
- `inHand` - The invoice is assumed by the buyer for processing.
- `refused` - The invoice has been refused by the recipient for business reasons. A complete list of reasons for refusal is available in the document "Annex 1 - Semantic Format FE e-invoicing - Flows 1 & 2" on the "Reason for refusal" tab.
- `paymentSent` - The bank transfer flow has been sent to the supplier / The reimbursement flow has been sent to the buyer.
- `paymentReceived` - The supplier has received payment of the invoice. This status is mandatory for supply of services (except VAT on debits and excluding reverse charge transactions).
- `disputed` - There is a dispute regarding the invoice. This may ultimately lead to refusal or approval by the buyer.
- `notSent` - The invoice has not been sent to the platform.
- `inTransit` - The invoice has been sent and is in transit between platforms.
- `approved` - The invoice has been approved by the buyer.
- `receivedByPlatform` - The invoice has been received by the public invoicing portal or the buyer’s registered private platform but has not yet been made available to the buyer.
- `rejectedByPlatform` - The invoice can be automatically rejected by the platform on technical grounds (e.g. format, non-compliance with the standard, etc.). When the transmit platform rejects the invoice, the invoice must be corrected by its issuer and resubmitted to the platform.
- `suspended` - Processing of the invoice is temporarily suspended.
- `completed` - The invoice processing lifecycle is completed.
- `partiallyApproved` - The invoice has been partially approved.

objects.purchasing.price-list-entry.description: A purchasing price list entry contains the pricing for a selected item within a selected price list. You can create price list entries for items whose prices are determined based on an amount, a discount or mark up percentage, the quantity sold, and more.

key.description: System assigned unique key for the price list entry.

id.description: Unique ID for the price list entry.

href.description: URL endpoint for the price list entry.

key.description: Unique key for the product line.

id.description: Unique name or other ID for the product line.

href.description: URL endpoint for the product line.

currency.description: Provide the currency in which the price will be evaluated. This field is only applicable to multi-currency companies.

startDate.description: Provide the date on which the price becomes effective. You can enter past or future dates.

endDate.description: Provide the date on which the price ends. You can enter past or future dates.

minimumQuantity.description: Specify a minimum quantity if you want to give or get price breaks according to the quantity ordered. With this type of pricing, the system multiplies the transaction quantity by the rate mapped to the quantity range in which the transaction quantity falls. Quantities cannot be negative.

maximumQuantity.description: Specify a maximum quantity if you want to give or get price breaks according to the quantity ordered. With this type of pricing, the system multiplies the transaction quantity by the rate mapped to the quantity range in which the transaction quantity falls. Quantities cannot be negative.

value.description:
The value to provide for this field depends on the type set in the `valueType` field:
* `actual`: Provide the price.  For example, if the item is $500.00, specify 500.00
* `dollarMarkup`: Provide the amount by which to mark up the price. For example, to mark up the price by $25.00, specify 25.00.
* `dollarDiscount`: Provide the amount to subtract from the price. For example, to give a $10.00 discount, specify 10.00.
* `markupPercent`: Provide the percentage by which to mark up the price. For example, to mark up the price by 20%, specify 20.
* `discountPercent`: Provide the percentage by which to discount the price. For example, to give a 5% discount, specify 5.

valueType.description: The value type for the purchasing price list entry.

isFixedPrice.description: Indicates whether the price is a fixed price. In a cascading (or layered) price list structure, the first time Sage Intacct finds `isFixedPrice` set to `true` for an item, it presents that price as the suggested price on the transaction regardless of any other price defined for that item in other price lists.
